kyoto_nagomi_teppan_zoronpa_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, chijimi, tonpei-yaki and soy-demi sauces from the teppan (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagomi_teppan_zoronpa_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, steak, seafood and egg dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagomi_teppan_zoronpa_sanjo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday and irregularly. Reservations taken. Appetizer ¥600 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し代600円」. 40 seats with a counter, second-floor tatami and private rooms for 2–20. Non-smoking. Cards and PayPay; no e-money. On Yanaginobanba below Sanjo. Part of the Zoronpa group — 串鉄板ぞろんぱ 室町仏光寺店 is already in data, and Tabelog lists two other Zoronpa shops in Kyoto.
kyoto_nagomi_teppan_zoronpa_sanjo.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Yanaginobanba below Sanjo, okonomiyaki and fresh fish] A warm two-storey teppan izakaya with sashimi, Wagyu rump steak, fluffy tartar okonomiyaki and chijimi, plus private rooms upstairs; staff are chatty in a good way, reviewers say. ¥600 appetizer. Open till midnight; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A sister of 串鉄板ぞろんぱ 室町仏光寺店, which is already in this app; Tabelog lists Zoronpa shops elsewhere in Kyoto, and this one is a corporate-member listing. Reviewers in 2024–2026 praise fresh seafood, a long menu and warm, well-timed service ("You might think they are just chatty, but that's not the case", June 2026); one October 2024 diner expected cooking in front of the table but the dishes came from the kitchen.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "To finish, I had the famous tartar okonomiyaki, which was unbelievably fluffy and absolutely amazing!"
August 2024: "I had assumed it was just a teppanyaki place focusing on okonomiyaki, but it turned out to be a 'Teppanyaki & Izakaya' offering fresh sashimi and seasonal daily specials."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和鉄板ぞろんぱ、居酒屋・魚介料理・鉄板焼き、中京区柳馬場三条下ル槌屋町102-1、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩6分、月・火・木〜日 17:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、水曜・不定休、予約可、原文で「お通し代600円」、40席、個室 (2〜20名)、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、法人会員。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年6月、英語): 鉄板と居酒屋、刺身 (鱧、まぐろ赤身、ぶりのたたき、たこ)、Taiza のセコガニ、タルタルのお好み焼き、東京風お好み焼き、とん平焼き、だし巻き、黒毛和牛ランプのステーキ、鯛のムニエル、芽キャベツや牡蠣のバターの串、ちりめんとあおさのチヂミ、燻製卵のポテサラ、たこのピリ辛サラダ、気まぐれぞろんぱサラダ、2階の座敷、気さくで心地よい接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms; ¥600 appetizer.

existence.note: Tabelog corporate-member listing with reviews through June 2026.

kyoto_yoshimura_daimaru_bettei.gf_detail: Ask: a 100% buckwheat soba is mentioned (October 2026), but tsuyu is soy-based and tempura sets are common — confirm the day's soba and dipping sauce (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yoshimura_daimaru_bettei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito-dashi tsuyu, tempura sets and tuna dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yoshimura_daimaru_bettei.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–16:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed 1–2 January with the store; 14:30–16:00 a soba-sweets café with à la carte soba; special menus at peak seasons (cherry blossom, Golden Week, Gion Matsuri, Obon, autumn, year-end). Reservations taken; waits of about 20 minutes at Obon lunch (August 2026). 53 seats with a counter. Non-smoking; wheelchair access. Cards; no e-money or QR. On the 8th floor of Daimaru Kyoto, directly connected to Karasuma / Shijo. Part of the よしむら soba group (嵐山よしむら, 蕎麦の実 よしむら, 北之蔵 よしむら北山楼 — yoshimura-gr.com); opened about three years ago (October 2026 review).
kyoto_yoshimura_daimaru_bettei.notes: [Soba · Daimaru Kyoto 8F, the Arashiyama Yoshimura group's city branch] A calm department-store branch of the Arashiyama soba house: handmade soba with the day's buckwheat origin explained, a good-value Daimaru Zen set with mini tendon, a three-soba tasting, and soba sweets in the afternoon. Expect short queues at peak times. Open daily with the store.

chef_bio.background: Part of the よしむら group (yoshimura-gr.com), whose main shop is Arashiyama Yoshimura near Togetsukyo, with 蕎麦の実 よしむら (Karasuma Gojo) and 北之蔵 よしむら北山楼; an October 2026 reviewer says the Daimaru branch opened about three years ago. One August 2026 diner calls it "part of a famous chain" and found the soba more refined than strong; reviewers praise reasonable prices for central Kyoto and the soba-yu.

anecdotes.text: October 2024: "The staff informed me, 'Today's soba is made from buckwheat flour sourced from Akita Prefecture.'"
October 2026: "I also appreciate that the shrimp tempura and green onions are served on a separate plate."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: よしむら 大丸京都別邸、そば・居酒屋・スイーツ、下京区四条通高倉西入立売西町79 大丸京都店 8F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から地下直結、毎日 11:00〜16:00・17:00〜21:00、1月1・2日休み、14:30〜16:00はそばスイーツのカフェと一品そば、繁忙期は特別メニュー、予約可、53席、禁煙、車椅子可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。公式サイト (よしむらグループ): 嵐山よしむら、蕎麦の実 よしむら、北之蔵 よしむら北山楼。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 大丸膳 (そば、ミニ天丼、小鉢) 1,780円、3種のそばの食べ比べ、限定の田舎そば、十割そば、その日のそば粉の産地 (秋田など) を教えてくれる、温かい海老天そば (天ぷらとねぎは別皿)、天おろしそば、そばの実のサラダ、まぐろとやまかけのそばの実、そばスイーツ、京都の柚子ソーダとそばかりんとう、開店から約3年 (2026年10月)、有名なチェーンの一つという声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store restaurant floor; short waits at peak times.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and group site, with reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_sakahoko_chanko.gf_detail: Ask. The broth is chicken-bone and soy sauce; finishes include udon (official site).
kyoto_sakahoko_chanko.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-bone broth with chicken and garlic meatballs (official site).
kyoto_sakahoko_chanko.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00; closing days irregular (official site; Tabelog). Closed for the summer in 2026 until after mid-September (official notice, 24 June 2026). Reservations taken; often full from opening to about 19:00 (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (official site; Tabelog). 26 seats at tables (Tabelog). Staff cook the hot pot at your table, from the order of ingredients to the finish (official site; 2024–2026 reviews). Take-away and nationwide delivery (official site). On Kiyamachi south of Takoyakushi, 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn exit 5 (official site).
kyoto_sakahoko_chanko.notes: [Chanko-nabe · Kiyamachi, a sumo wrestler's shop since 1966] Opened in 1966 by the wrestler Sakahoko Yojiro of the Izutsu stable, and still serving its chanko: a chicken-bone and soy broth with garlicky house meatballs, cooked at the table by staff, then finished as mochi zosui. About ¥4,000 a head before the finish; cash only; book ahead in winter.

chef_bio.background: The official site says the restaurant was opened in Kiyamachi in 1966 by the 8th Sakahoko (逆鉾 與治郎, Sakahoko Yojiro), and still serves the Izutsu-stable chanko introduced by the founder, with a traditional broth and special meatballs; geiko, maiko and kabuki actors have long been guests. A January 2025 reviewer was told by the three women running it that a local took it over when no successor was found.
chef_bio.philosophy: Every hot pot is made by the staff, from the order of ingredients to the heat and timing, so guests need not lift a finger (official site).

anecdotes.text: A January 2024 diner arrived at 17:00; by 18:00 the shop was full and turning people away.
A February 2025 guest noted a signature of the singer Saburo Kitajima displayed inside.
A November 2026 visitor came as the weather turned cold and switched the soy broth to spicy miso halfway.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都木屋町のちゃんこ鍋 逆鉾、京都市中京区木屋町通蛸薬師下る下樵木町203-5、阪急河原町駅5番出口から徒歩3分、京阪祇園四条駅3番出口から徒歩4分、17:00〜22:00、不定休、カード不可、全国発送・持ち帰り可、1966年に八代目逆鉾 (逆鉾 與治郎) が開業、芸舞妓や歌舞伎役者も来店、井筒部屋直伝の味、鶏ガラ醤油の出汁、にんにくの効いた特製肉団子、ちゃんこ鍋は全てスタッフが作る。メニュー: ソップ鍋 (付き出し・肉団子・鶏肉・野菜) 1人前3,950円、うま辛ちゃんこ、〆はうどん380円・もち380円・雑炊640円・もち雑炊820円、ビール中瓶670円、熱燗550円、玉乃光、焼酎「逆鉾」590円から。2026年6月24日: 夏季 (9月中頃過ぎ) まで休業。食べログ: 26席、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 女将が鍋を作る、うま辛味噌で味を変える、北島三郎のサイン、三人の女性が切り盛り、地元の人が継いだ、開店から19時ごろまで満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; staff cook at the table.

existence.note: Official site (summer-closure notice June 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_pizzeria_brown_blossom.gf_detail: Not GF: wood-fired wheat-dough pizza (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_pizzeria_brown_blossom.vegan_detail: Ask. The marinara is tomato-based with no cheese listed; other pizzas carry mozzarella or prosciutto (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_pizzeria_brown_blossom.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Friday 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00; closed Tuesday and some other days (Tabelog). Reservations taken; walk-ins often seated (2025 reviews). Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). 26 seats: a 1st-floor counter and tables, more tables upstairs by a steep staircase; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Lunch and dinner menus are the same (August 2026). Pizzas are about 30 cm and cut by yourself (February 2025; February 2026). In a converted townhouse south of Shijo, within walking distance of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; January and October 2026).
kyoto_pizzeria_brown_blossom.notes: [Pizzeria · off Shijo, wood-fired in a townhouse] A small wood-fired pizzeria in a converted townhouse south of Shijo, run single-handed and turning out big, chewy-crusted Neapolitan pizzas fast. Margherita about ¥1,900; the mushroom Bismarck and quattro formaggi are favourites. Counter downstairs, tables up a steep stair; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in May 2022 (Tabelog). An August 2026 reviewer describes a pizza shop run by a single person, turning out pizzas remarkably fast from the wood-fired oven at the back; others note the converted townhouse and steep stairs.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fragrant Neapolitan dough of carefully chosen flour, baked in a wood-fired oven (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 pair could not believe one person was making the pizzas so quickly.
A January 2026 party of four had the shared pizzas sent out one at a time so each arrived hot.
A May 2025 walk-in arrived just after 21:00 and still made the 21:30 last order.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: PIZZERIA Brown Blossom、ピザ・イタリアン、京都市下京区足袋屋町317-2、月・水〜金 17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、土日祝 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:30〜22:00、火曜定休、不定休あり、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、26席、禁煙、2022年5月1日オープン、厳選した小麦粉の香り高いナポリピッツァを薪窯で。メニュー (2025年1月): マリナーラ・マルゲリータ1,680円、クアトロフォルマッジ・水牛のマルゲリータ1,980円、サルシッチャとフリアリエッリ1,980円、グリーンサラダ780円、カプレーゼ1,280円、水牛モッツァレラと生ハム1,980円、チョコレートケーキ・チーズケーキ580円、ジェラート480円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 町家を改装、急な階段、1階カウンター、2階テーブル、30cm以上の大きなピザ、自分で切る、マルゲリータ1,900円、きのこのビスマルク2,200円 (2026年8月)、イタリアビール700円ほど、ひとりで切り盛り、薪窯。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; steep stairs to the upper floor.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_iwayaki_pontocho_kotoshi.gf_detail: Ask. Stone-grilled meat and seafood, lunch sets with tempura, hot pots, udon and homemade tofu; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_iwayaki_pontocho_kotoshi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, duck, hamo and seafood sets (reviews).
kyoto_iwayaki_pontocho_kotoshi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 daily; dinner 17:00–24:00 Monday–Friday, 16:00–24:00 Saturday, 16:00–23:00 Sunday and holidays; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations taken; riverside seats book up (November 2025). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 10% service charge, 5% more for private rooms (Tabelog). 56 seats with tatami and private rooms; a Kamo River noryo-yuka from 1 May to 30 September; designated smoking area (Tabelog; 2024 reviews).  On Pontocho north of Shijo, 4 min from Kawaramachi Stn exit 1 (Tabelog).
kyoto_iwayaki_pontocho_kotoshi.notes: [Iwayaki & Kyoto lunch · Pontocho, on the Kamo yuka] A long-running Pontocho restaurant with a summer yuka over the Kamo, known for stone-grilled meat and good-value lunch sets — hamo, duck curry udon or a seafood bowl with homemade tofu, about ¥2,000–2,900. Dinner runs to wagyu tataki and duck hot pot. 10% service; open to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a long-established Pontocho restaurant facing the Kamo River with a red-themed interior, tatami rooms and a seasonal riverside yuka, serving meat-centred dishes and Kyoto lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 family brought a mother with walking difficulties, who realised a dream of riverside dining in Kyoto.
A June 2024 diner on the cool yuka had the duck and Kujo-onion curry udon lunch with three side dishes and sherbet.
An August 2026 family took a river table at noon in mid-August heat, for the cold beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 岩焼 先斗町 ことし、フレンチ・ステーキ・創作料理、京都市中京区先斗町通四条上ル松本町163、阪急河原町駅1番出口から徒歩4分、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00、夜 月〜金17:00〜24:00・土16:00〜24:00・日祝16:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、カード可、電子マネー不可、サービス料10%、個室料5%、56席、個室あり、分煙、鴨川納涼床は5月1日〜9月30日、岩焼 (石で焼く魚介・肉・野菜)。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 鴨川に面した老舗、赤を基調にした店内、座敷、鱧鍋御膳2,000円ほど、鱧の刺身・天ぷら・小鍋、手作り豆腐、鴨と九条ねぎのカレーうどんランチ1,890円、海鮮丼と天ぷらとうどん2,900円、和牛のたたき、鴨鍋と雑炊、夜は1人6,000円ほど、床の席は予約で埋まる。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; 10% service; riverside yuka in summer.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026. The website on Tabelog (kotoshi-pontcyo.com) did not respond on 2026-11-07.

kyoto_daikoku_ebisu_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with sauces and salt, yukhoe and rice bowls; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_daikoku_ebisu_pontocho.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and the day after a holiday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Friday–Sunday, holidays and holiday eves also 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations taken; heavily intoxicated guests may be refused (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: a 6-seat counter downstairs; tables, a sofa seat and two tatami rooms upstairs; heated tobacco only in a designated area (Tabelog). Smartphone ordering and English menu descriptions; many foreign guests (2026 reviews). In a townhouse in an alley off Pontocho north of Shijo, 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_daikoku_ebisu_pontocho.notes: [Yakiniku · Pontocho, Kobe beef in a townhouse] A townhouse yakiniku off Pontocho, sister to Daikoku Ebisu in Saiin, grilling Kobe beef and wagyu at fair prices — the special platter is ¥6,000 — plus a sparkly little rice bowl of Ran-ou egg. Counter downstairs, tatami and sofas upstairs; English menu; open daily, lunch at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Opened in May 2023 (Tabelog). A Tabelog reviewer notes it as a new Pontocho branch of the Saiin yakiniku 大黒戎; the shop stresses domestic wagyu and a signature small rice bowl made with Oita Ran-ou eggs (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe beef yakiniku; Ran-ou egg small rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 cherry-blossom walker stumbled on it after Kyoto Gyoen and found Kobe beef at a fair price.
An October 2026 parent and daughter ordered salted tongue, thick-cut tongue and skirt several times over in a semi-private room.
A September 2026 bar-hopper made it the eighth stop of the night, with imo shochu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉ダイニング 大黒戎 先斗町店、焼肉・ホルモン、京都市中京区下樵木町203-9、阪急河原町駅から北へ徒歩5分、月〜木・祝翌日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、金土日祝・祝前日 11:30〜15:30 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜23:00、年中無休、予約可、泥酔の方は入店を断る場合あり、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、30席 (カウンター6、テーブル、ソファ、座敷2)、加熱式たばこのみの喫煙所、2023年5月25日オープン、大分県の蘭王卵の「魅惑の小丼」、国産和牛へのこだわり。メニュー (2023年): 神戸牛カルビ・ロース2,200円、神戸牛赤身1,800円、特上ハラミ1,480円、ホルモン盛り合わせ2,500円、うにといくらのユッケ1,880円。口コミ (2026年、英語): 町家、特選盛り合わせ6,000円、厚切りタン1,780円、キムチ盛り合わせ580円、魅惑の小丼1,960円、スマホで注文、英語の案内、外国からの客が多い、西院の大黒戎の姉妹店。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu descriptions; smartphone ordering; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_taishu_sakaba_woniwa.gf_detail: Ask. A long izakaya menu of sashimi, salads, hot pots finished with ramen or zosui, fried and teppan dishes, kimbap; no gluten information (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_woniwa.vegan_detail: Ask. Edamame, salted cabbage and chilled tofu are listed, but nothing is said about dashi or sauces; most of the menu is meat and fish (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_woniwa.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 17:00–23:00, Friday 17:00–23:30, Saturday 12:00–23:30, Sunday and holidays 12:00–23:00; closed on irregular days (Tabelog). An otoshi starter is charged (Tabelog, original 別途お通し代あり). Reservations recommended for window seats (August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 71 seats incl. sofas by the windows with a night view (Tabelog; May 2026). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). Ordering by smartphone QR (July and August 2026). On the 9th floor of タカセビル just across Sanjo bridge, 2 min from Keihan Sanjo — not the ground floor, as Google Maps shows (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 1 February 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_woniwa.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo, a 9th-floor Kamo river view] A big, bright, cheap izakaya on the 9th floor just over Sanjo bridge, with sofa seats facing the Kamo river and Higashiyama — book a window for the night view. Sashimi, Korean dishes, hot pots and kimbap, ordered by QR; popular items sell out. Several reviewers found the staff unfriendly. Otoshi charged. Flagged: an Osaka operator.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T4140001112611 is registered to 株式会社FranK of Osaka (NTA register); no other shops of the company were found. Reviewers praise the view, prices and quick drinks (July and August 2026); three reviewers found the staff unfriendly (April, May and August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Izakaya dishes with a river view.

anecdotes.text: On the night of the Gozan Okuribi in August 2026, a passer-by found the window seats full but a table free, and stayed for cheap, quick drinks.
An August 2026 diner was told half the QR menu was not actually sold out and could be ordered by asking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 大衆酒場 をにわ 河原町店、居酒屋・肉料理・海鮮、中京区三条通東入ル中島町105 タカセビル 9F、阪急京都河原町駅1A出口から徒歩5分、月〜木 17:00〜23:00、金 17:00〜23:30、土 12:00〜23:30、日・祝 12:00〜23:00、不定休、お通し代あり、カード・電子マネー・QR可、71席 (夜景の見える席)、喫煙所あり、2024年2月1日オープン、刺身、三種盛り1,099円、牛ユッケ、鍋 (水炊き、チゲ、博多明太もつ、白湯) 1人1,099円から、締めのラーメン・雑炊439円、塩キャベツ、よだれ鶏、豚キムチ、適格請求書 T4140001112611 (株式会社FranK、大阪)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 鴨川と東山の眺め、ソファ席、肉キンパ、サーモンカツ、ひよこの器の卵黄をのせる肉豆腐、安い飲み放題、記念日ケーキ1,000円、QRで注文、品切れが多い、スタッフの対応が悪いとの声が複数。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering on your phone; otoshi charged.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_gion_kurashita.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki, yudofu, Tanba-jidori hot pot with Kujo onions and hamo-shabu finished with zosui; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kurashita.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the yudofu kaiseki includes sashimi, and the hot pots are chicken broth or hamo (2026 reviews; Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kurashita.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:00) daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original サービス料１０％). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 41 seats: 5 at the counter and 36 at tables and in tatami rooms; parties up to 18 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Maiko can be arranged for parties upstairs (Tabelog). On Hanamikoji in south Gion, 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog). Opened 11 September 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kurashita.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Hanamikoji, yudofu and jidori hot pot] A calm Hanamikoji restaurant behind a menu-less front, with a five-seat counter, tables and tatami rooms: yudofu kaiseki at lunch, Tanba-jidori hot pot with Kujo onions, hamo-shabu in summer, and courses from about ¥6,000. Maiko can be booked for parties upstairs. 10% service charge.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T2810961127739 is registered to an individual, 蔵下 智 (NTA register). Tabelog’s shop text says counter guests enjoy watching the cooking and talking with the cooks. An October 2026 diner found the owner kind and helpful.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 pair booked the hamo-shabu course the day before, added more hamo and vegetables, and were directed by the owner to a nearby shop for Gion Matsuri souvenirs.
An August 2026 diner tried Iyo Mankai, a sake from ancient red rice with a plum-wine sweetness.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇園京料理くらした、花見小路の和食京料理店、懐石料理、湯豆腐、水炊きなどの鍋物、鱧、個室お座敷とカウンター、湯豆腐会席などのランチ、接待や顔合わせにも。食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮、東山区祇園町南側570-157、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜15:00 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.20:00)、サービス料10%、カード・電子マネー・QR可、41席 (カウンター5、テーブル36)、禁煙、2010年9月11日オープン、二日炊いたスープの丹波地鶏の鍋と九条ねぎ、日本酒はAozoraとTamagawaなど、2階で舞妓さんの宴席も、コース6,050〜25,300円、適格請求書 T2810961127739 (蔵下 智)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 湯豆腐と刺身の6,500円のコース、伊予の古代米の酒、鱧しゃぶのコース7,000円と雑炊。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter, tables and tatami rooms; 10% service charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_tsubaki_kappo.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki and à la carte Japanese dishes, grilled fish, Chateaubriand, clay-pot rice; the shop asks to be told about allergies when booking (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tsubaki_kappo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, crab and beef; small dishes include marinated tuna and grouper (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tsubaki_kappo.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 (reservation only) and 18:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sunday and the 1st and 3rd Monday (own site). Tabelog lists Monday–Saturday 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:30 — the shop’s own hours are used. Reservations accepted; seat-only bookings are asked for one order each (Tabelog). No service charge or cover; private-room plans include a room fee (Tabelog, original サービス料・チャージ：なし ※個室プランには個室料含む). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 14 counter seats, a private room for 2–6 downstairs and three rooms upstairs for up to 24 (own site). Maiko and geiko can be arranged (own site). Non-smoking (Tabelog). At the north-west corner of 松竹小路 in south Gion (own site). Opened 26 May 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_tsubaki_kappo.notes: [Kappo · south Gion, counter and private rooms] A warm south-Gion restaurant with a 14-seat counter and private rooms: seasonal à la carte starting with three small bites, or omakase ¥22,000 including service, and lunch courses around ¥7,000. Homemade karasumi and clay-pot rice; maiko can be arranged. No service charge. Closed Sunday and 1st and 3rd Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社椿, registered at the shop’s own lot (NTA register). Tabelog’s shop text invites guests to watch and chat with the chefs at the counter. Reviewers describe a friendly owner and staff who remember returning guests (June and October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients prepared to be colourful and lovely to look at (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal à la carte; homemade karasumi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner who could not finish the course had the last dish, the seasoned rice, packed as onigiri and enjoyed it the next day.
An October 2026 group of six at a pre-wedding family meeting all had seconds of the clay-pot rice, and the staff offered to take photos.
A June 2026 visitor came on the recommendation of a geisha at the teahouse the family visits every year.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇園 椿、東山区祇園町南側570-148 (松竹小路北西角)、11:30〜14:00 (予約のみ)、18:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、日曜と第1・第3月曜定休、1階カウンター14席・個室1室 (2〜6名)、2階3室 (2〜24名)、おまかせ料理22,000円 (税サ込)、予算に応じたコース、単品料理も、個室料別途、舞妓・芸妓の手配。食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮・肉料理、サービス料・チャージなし、カード・PayPay可、禁煙、2016年5月26日オープン、適格請求書 T2130001060152 (株式会社椿)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): アラカルトは先付3品から、甘鯛、7,000円の昼のコース、ハタの漬け、まぐろの漬け、銀杏の素揚げ、鰆の焼き物、蟹、シャトーブリアン、松茸の炊き込みご飯、茄子の煮物、羽二重のデザート、自家製からすみ、土鍋ご飯、おにぎりの持ち帰り、アルザスのリースリング。

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly to first-timers (2026 reviews); private rooms; no service charge.

kyoto_izakaya_iiiro_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and dashimaki may suit, but kushi-age, gratin, spring rolls and soy-seasoned dishes are not (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_iiiro_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, bone-in chicken, braised pork, seafood gratin (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_iiiro_karasuma.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00; closed Mondays, but groups can ask (Tabelog). Bookings taken; private hire by phone; no all-you-can-eat or drink as standard, but ask ahead (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 28 seats, a tatami room; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). 1–3 min from Hankyu Karasuma / Shijo Stn, on Sakaimachi (Tabelog; August 2026 review).
kyoto_izakaya_iiiro_karasuma.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma] A casual izakaya a minute from Karasuma with oil-drum tables and 70s–80s music, cheap draft beer and Kagawa-style bone-in chicken, dashimaki, gratin and good-value sashimi, until midnight. About ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2024 (Tabelog). A young owner, keen and careful, with music from the 1970s and 80s (February 2025 review). Tables made from oil drums (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: After a live show nearby in July 2025, a group came around 9 pm and found the ¥1,200 sashimi platter of fish from Obama, Fukui the best value.
An August 2026 solo diner, alone in the room at 7 pm, paired the peppery bone-in chicken with a tea highball the house recommended.
A February 2025 diner of the 70s–80s generation enjoyed the music and the clean rooms.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋いいいろ、居酒屋・串揚げ、下京区小石町115-3 日宝堺町センタ1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩約1分、火〜日 17:00〜24:00、月曜休み (団体は相談可)、予約可、飲み放題・食べ放題は通常なし (事前に相談可)、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、28席、座敷、禁煙、車いす可、英語メニュー、子ども可、2024年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): Kagawa の骨付き鶏1,300円、自家製ホワイトソースの海鮮グラタン900円、甘くないだし巻き650円、ちくわきゅうり380円、生ビール450円、お茶のハイボール600円、Obama (Fukui) の魚の刺身盛り1,200円、梅ソースのいわしの揚げ物、角煮、揚げなす、枝豆とチーズの春巻き、doteni、若い店主、ドラム缶のテーブル。

kyoto_reims_japone_gokomachi.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly pasta, tarts and cakes; a fish-and-shrimp rice set exists (2026 reviews).
kyoto_reims_japone_gokomachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: carbonara, cream pasta, cheese tarts (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_reims_japone_gokomachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–17:00 (food L.O. 16:00, drinks 16:30), closed Tuesdays. Gurunavi (undated): 11:30–22:00, Saturdays and the day before holidays to 23:00, closed Tuesdays; a June 2026 reviewer also found it open late. Bookings for meals; no online bookings for café use (Tabelog). One drink per person (September 2026 review). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 58 seats including a 7-seat terrace; smoking only on the terrace; children welcome (Tabelog). On Gokomachi south of Sanjo, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi exit 9 (Tabelog).
kyoto_reims_japone_gokomachi.notes: [Café & bistro · Gokomachi] A big, quirky-looking café-bistro on Gokomachi with a terrace: cheap filling pasta lunches, a counter full of tarts and cakes, and coffee by the size. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.background: Hanging lamps each of a different design and a stylish counter at the back (September 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A regular who eats a lot of fish comes back for the rich, bacon-heavy carbonara — six visits from 2025 to August 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the ¥880 daily special disappointing — two small soy kara-age, a little stewed fish — and suggested the free large pasta instead.
On 5 September 2026 a walker spotted a seasonal fig tart in the showcase and paired it with a bitter iced coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ランス ジャポネ (REIMS JAPONE)、ビストロ・カフェ・居酒屋、中京区御幸町通三条下ル八百屋町111、阪急京都河原町駅9番出口から徒歩約3分、11:30〜17:00 (料理 L.O. 16:00、ドリンク L.O. 16:30)、火曜休み、カフェ利用のネット予約不可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、58席 (テラス7)、喫煙はテラスのみ、子ども可。ぐるなび (日付不明): 11:30〜22:00、土・祝前日は23:00まで、火曜休み。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ベーコンたっぷりのカルボナーラ、スモークサーモンのクリームのタリアテッレ1,100円、日替わり880円、平日は大盛り無料、チーズタルト、アップルタルト、いちじくのタルト、モンブラン、ケーキ2個1,040円、飲み物は S・M・L、1人1ドリンク。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual café; children welcome.

kyoto_kofukudo_matsubara.gf_detail: Ask. Mochi, daifuku and dango are rice-based, but dorayaki, monaka and baked sweets are wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kofukudo_matsubara.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste mochi and daifuku are often plant-based, but cream daifuku, dorayaki and some sweets use dairy or egg (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kofukudo_matsubara.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 9:00–18:30; closed Wednesdays (Tabelog); the shop's site gives the Matsubara main shop 9:00–18:00. No cards; e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). Takeaway; a place to eat at the entrance with free tea (November 2025 and March 2026 reviews). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Near Kawaramachi–Matsubara, about 7 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (July 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kofukudo_matsubara.notes: [Wagashi · Matsubara] A long-established wagashi shop near Kawaramachi–Matsubara, founded in 1868 and now in its fifth generation: stretchy mame daifuku, yomogi mochi, fruit daifuku, seasonal mochi and red rice, mostly ¥200–400 a piece, with tea offered if you eat in front. A second shop is in Nishiki Market.

chef_bio.background: Founded in Meiji 1 (1868) by 花川幸二郎; the bean-paste method has been handed down to the fifth generation (own site). Two shops: the Matsubara main shop and a Nishiki shop at 錦小路通麩屋町西入ル (own site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Keeps the founding method of making bean paste (own site).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 passer-by, drawn by a crowd, noted that overseas visitors especially like the ¥86 half-baked sweets, and chose kuzumochi for the heat.
A former neighbour who used to buy New Year mochi here came back in December 2025 and liked the mandarin daifuku best.
A March 2026 walker who asked to eat on the spot was offered tea with a sakura mochi and three-colour dango.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 幸福堂、和菓子、下京区松原通河原町西入松川町388-2、清水五条駅から347m、月・火・木〜日 9:00〜18:30、水曜休み、カード不可、電子マネー・PayPay 可、禁煙、テイクアウト。公式サイト: 明治元年に初代 花川幸二郎が創業、五代目まで餡の製法を受け継ぐ、松原本店 (9:00〜18:00) と錦店 (中京区錦小路通麩屋町西入ル梅屋町501、10:00〜17:00)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 豆大福220〜230円、手打ちよもぎ大福220円、くずもち230円、いちご大福400円、半生菓子86円、栗大福とどら焼き、栗餅270円、栗羊羹280円、みかん大福400円、桜餅、三色団子、くずきりのアイス、金魚の半生菓子90円、店先で食べるとお茶のサービス。

cultural_comfort.note: Point-and-buy wagashi counter; popular with overseas visitors (June 2025 review).

kyoto_kanizamurai_bettei_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Boiled crab and sashimi may suit, but tempura, cream croquettes, shumai and fried crab are wheat (2025 reviews).
kyoto_kanizamurai_bettei_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a crab restaurant (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kanizamurai_bettei_pontocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the days around holidays 17:00–22:30; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; food L.O. 21:30, drinks 22:00 (Tabelog); no weekday lunch in July and August 2026 (Tabelog notice). Bookings taken; a ¥500 seat charge on the kawadoko from May to October (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: sunken kotatsu, tables and private rooms for up to 6; non-smoking; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome (Tabelog). On Pontocho near Sanjo, 5 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_kanizamurai_bettei_pontocho.notes: [Crab · Pontocho] A Pontocho crab restaurant known for its all-you-can-eat king crab course, with sunken-kotatsu rooms and a summer kawadoko over the Kamo River (¥500 a seat). English menu. About ¥6,000–15,000 at dinner.

chef_bio.background: Sister of 京都錦市場 かに侍 (own site). Staff service praised in February 2025; staff recommend arriving early on the kawadoko for the sunset (August 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner on the all-you-can-eat course got three buckets of boiled crab, croquettes, tempura, crab miso and zosui, and was a little scared of crab afterwards.
On the August 2025 kawadoko a diner ordered king-crab butter steak and crab shumai, and took the staff's advice to come early for the sunset.
With everywhere else booked over the January 2026 holidays, a diner found a same-day table here and added taraba crab to a course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都先斗町 かに侍別邸、かに、中京区先斗町通橋下町133-1 エメラルド会館1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、平日・祝前後日 17:00〜22:30、土日祝 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30、ドリンク L.O. 22:00)、2026年7〜8月は平日の昼の営業なし、予約可、5〜10月の川床は1席500円、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、30席 (掘りごたつ16、テーブル8、個室6)、禁煙、英語メニュー・英語対応、子ども可。公式サイト: 姉妹店は京都錦市場 かに侍。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): タラバガニ食べ放題のコース、ゆでがにのバケツ、かにクリームコロッケ、かにの天ぷら、かに味噌、かに雑炊、4歳以下無料・12歳まで半額、かにの刺身、タラバガニのバターステーキ、太巻き、かにシュウマイ、川床と夕日。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (July–August 2026 notice) and own site; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_wine_bar_verite_gion.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar; the sources mention no food at all.
kyoto_wine_bar_verite_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. A wine bar; the sources mention no food, and no information on fining agents in the wines.
kyoto_wine_bar_verite_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; whole-bar hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking room inside (Tabelog). Over-18s only (Tabelog). Sommelier (Tabelog). Kiritoshi Building 3F, Kiyomotocho, 5 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_wine_bar_verite_gion.notes: [Wine bar · Gion, since 2024] A seven-seat, wood-lined counter bar on a third floor in Gion with a glass-walled walk-in cellar, run by a young Kyoto-born owner with deep Burgundy knowledge. Champagne, Burgundy and old vintages by recommendation, until 2:00. Reviewers spend ¥10,000 and up. Over-18s only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner and sommelier (unnamed); born and raised in Kyoto (June 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2025 review: the young owner, born and raised in Kyoto, previously worked at the Gion Kenzo Estate Winery. Opened February 2024 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor found the owner a little shy but open about a love of Burgundy.
A July 2025 visitor enjoyed the owner’s stories from first-hand wine experiences and wanted to stay longer.
An August 2026 guest could not follow the niche talk but stayed about six hours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインバー、東山区清本町364-5 切通しビル 3F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝18:00〜翌2:00、日曜休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター7席、貸切20名まで、店内に喫煙室、未成年不可、ソムリエ、2024年2月3日オープン、大きなウォークインセラーに世界のワインと古いヴィンテージ。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都生まれ京都育ちの若い店主は祇園の Kenzo Estate のワイナリーの出身、ブルゴーニュに詳しい、シャンパーニュ、熟成ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Tell the owner what you like and a budget; bottles by recommendation. No English evidence found.

kyoto_gion_taotei.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: noodles and ramen to finish, sweet and sour pork, shrimp chili (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_taotei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sweet and sour pork, shrimp chili, chicken and tofu stew, jellyfish (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_taotei.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday and the second Sunday (the next day if that is a holiday); temporary closures announced on Instagram gion.taotei (official site; Tabelog gives dinner to 22:00 and lunch last order 13:30). Reservations accepted; walk-ins have been seated at lunch (Tabelog; June 2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％」). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 25 seats: a 5-seat counter and four tatami private rooms with Taisho-era craftsmanship; banquets to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Maiko can be invited by arrangement (Tabelog). On Hanamikoji, diagonally across from the Kaburenjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_taotei.notes: [Chinese in a Gion teahouse · Hanamikoji] Gentle, additive-free Chinese cooking served in the tatami rooms of a 1917 Hanamikoji teahouse once frequented by the novelist Junichiro Tanizaki — a chicken and tofu stew from one of the stories, shrimp chili, fruit-sauced sweet and sour pork, and a celebrated homemade almond tofu. Lunch sets by day; maiko can be invited. 10% service; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a Chinese restaurant in a roughly 100-year-old machiya, opened as a teahouse in 1917 and frequented by the novelist Junichiro Tanizaki; the four private rooms keep Taisho-era craftsmanship.
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy "zashiki Chinese" for every day, made without chemical seasonings (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 family celebrated a grandchild’s first-meal ceremony in a large tatami room, beside a framed passage from a Tanizaki novel.
A June 2026 solo diner walked in at lunch and was a little overwhelmed to get a whole tatami room alone.
A September 2026 diner saw a Gion geiko playing shamisen during the evening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: 中国料理、東山区祇園町南側570-120、花見小路の歌舞練場の斜め向かい、火〜日11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00) と17:30〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、月曜と第2日曜休み、サービス料10%、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、25席 (カウンター5と個室4)、禁煙、舞妓を呼べる、1917年 (大正6年) のお茶屋だった築100年の町家、谷崎潤一郎が通った、化学調味料を使わない「座敷中華」。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 鯛のカルパッチョ、くらげ、鶏の煮込み、エビチリ、果汁の酢豚、締めの麺と炒飯とラーメン、谷崎の小説に出てくる鶏と豆腐の煮込み、ブロッコリーの炒飯、自家製の杏仁豆腐、油淋鶏のランチ、白米と玄米。

cultural_comfort.note: Tatami rooms; ask when booking about inviting a maiko. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kawaramachi_yakiniku_ando.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tare-marinated meats, cold noodles and kimchi platters (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews); salt is offered as an alternative to tare (August 2026), but no gluten information.
kyoto_kawaramachi_yakiniku_ando.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu and horumon yakiniku house; namul and vegetable wraps exist as sides (April 2024).
kyoto_kawaramachi_yakiniku_ando.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–0:00 (last order 23:00); irregular closures; may close early when stock runs out (Tabelog). A February 2024 diner found it open all day on a Saturday. Reservations accepted, incl. online; Friday walk-ins have been seated (Tabelog; November 2025; August 2026). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」). Cards, e-money and QR; ordering by QR code at the table (Tabelog; August 2026). 31 seats: a 7-seat counter and 24 at tables; whole-floor hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; March 2024). English menu (Tabelog). Upstairs from the long-established coffee shop Rokuyosha, Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog). Opened 1 September 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kawaramachi_yakiniku_ando.notes: [Yakiniku and horumon · Kawaramachi, since 2018] A casual second-floor yakiniku house above the Rokuyosha coffee shop, open to midnight: fresh horumon platters, lean wagyu, tongue, homemade kimchi and namul, and half portions that suit solo diners at the counter. One of four Ando shops in Kyoto. Smoking allowed; English menu; QR ordering.

roles: Manager (unnamed), described as friendly and attentive (August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a yakiniku and horumon restaurant opened in September 2018, one of four ホルモン安東 shops in Kyoto (main shop, Kawaramachi, Higashiyama and Yamashina).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner arrived 20 minutes late for a 10 pm booking and was still welcomed; the manager split the horumon platter into well-matched portions.
A February 2026 marathon runner refuelled on a horumon platter and found even the liver to taste.
A February 2024 diner rated the beef-tendon stew, under ¥500, the best dish of the night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: 焼肉・ホルモン、中京区大黒町40-1 六曜社 2F、地下鉄京都市役所前駅から徒歩4分、毎日17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、不定休、仕入れにより早じまいあり、予約可、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、31席 (カウンター7、テーブル24)、喫煙可、英語メニュー、2018年9月1日オープン、京都に4店 (本店、河原町、東山、山科)、和牛とホルモン、自家製のキムチ、ナムル、冷麺、スンドゥブ、ハーフサイズ。口コミ (2023年7月〜2026年8月、英語): ナムルの盛り合わせ900円、野菜巻き700円、ホソ980円、premium rib 1,600円、ユッケ約5種、牛すじの煮込み、ニラキムチ、牡蠣のキムチ、ホルモンの盛り合わせ、センマイとハツの刺身、ハラミ、タン2,200円、QR で注文、一人焼肉にも。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and QR ordering (Tabelog; August 2026); counter seats suit solo diners.

kyoto_teppan_osake_souya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tonpei-yaki, taro kara-age and other teppan dishes with sauces (2025 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_osake_souya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashimaki, beef tendon, horumon and chicken dishes; many vegetable plates, but with dashi and bonito (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_osake_souya.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–3:00; irregular closures announced on Instagram; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations by phone only; weekend nights fill up (Tabelog; December 2025; May 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 28 seats: a 10-seat counter, 16 at tables and 2 standing (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Residential street — keep noise down late at night (Tabelog). 1 min from the Kawaramachi Matsubara bus stop, 7 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 5 October 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_osake_souya.notes: [Teppan and sake · Kawaramachi Matsubara, open to 3 am] A lively little teppan izakaya near Kawaramachi Matsubara, open every night until 3:00, with a menu that changes often: thick dashimaki with Kujo green onion, pork-and-cabbage omelette skewers, yodare-dori, shiba-zuke salads, horumon, and a big, well-described sake list. Weekend nights need a phone booking; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppan and sake izakaya opened in October 2017 near Kawaramachi Matsubara.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner was delighted to see shiba-zuke, usually hidden in a bento corner, star in a salad.
A December 2025 pair ate to bursting and paid ¥9,000 for two.
A June 2026 diner at the counter by the open front enjoyed watching the teppan chef work the spatula.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・鉄板焼き、下京区石不動之町700、河原町松原バス停から徒歩1分、阪急河原町駅から徒歩7分、毎日18:00〜翌3:00、不定休 (Instagram で告知)、電話予約のみ、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、28席 (カウンター10、テーブル16、立ち2)、喫煙可、住宅街なので深夜は静かに、2017年10月5日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 深夜3時まで、ポテトサラダ550円、よだれ鶏、Kujo ねぎとしらすのだし巻き800円、大根と牛すじの煮物700円、豚とキャベツの卵の串900円、いぶりがっこのマスカルポーネ、とん平焼き、里芋の唐揚げ、湯葉と黒ごま豆腐、ホルモン、柴漬けのサラダ、奄美の黒糖焼酎、日本酒が充実、アヒージョ、2人で9,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings only; staff have checked for seats for people waiting outside (May 2026). No English evidence found.

kyoto_kyogamo_osoba_riku_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask: the finishing soba is described as 100% buckwheat (October 2026), but the dipping sauces, tsukune and fried sides need checking (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyogamo_osoba_riku_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an all-you-can-eat Kyoto-duck restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyogamo_osoba_riku_sanjo.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); closing days may vary. Reservations taken; more than 10 minutes late counts as a cancellation; private hire by phone. Charge ¥418 including tax — Tabelog, Japanese original 「418円（税込）」. 32 seats with counter and sofas. Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi. Cards; no e-money or QR. 4F-A of 三条木屋町ビル on Sanjo east of Kawaramachi, behind a fire door bearing the shop's nameplate (October 2026). Opened 5 October 2026 (reviews).
kyoto_kyogamo_osoba_riku_sanjo.notes: [Kyoto duck · Sanjo-Kiyamachi, all-you-can-eat grill and shabu] Opened October 2026 behind an unmarked-looking fire door on a 4th floor: eat-all Kyoto duck you sear on a teppan rim and swish in the broth below, with tsukune, obanzai and 100% buckwheat soba to finish, about ¥6,000–7,000. ¥418 charge. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 October 2026 (September and October 2026 reviews; HotPepper listed it as opening that day). Tabelog lists it as a corporate member; no source names the operator — one October 2026 reviewer called it the "Kyoto Kawaramachi Branch", but no other shop was found. Reviewers praise fresh, light duck, staff who set up the leek ring for grilling, and attentive service.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "First, the staff made a circle with green onions and garlic chives, and I grilled the duck meat inside that circle."
October 2026: "The fat from the grilled duck dives right into the shabu-shabu, enhancing the flavor of the duck."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京鴨とお蕎麦 陸、居酒屋・しゃぶしゃぶ・そば、中京区三条通河原町東入中島町96 三条木屋町ビル 4F A区画、京阪三条駅7番出口から徒歩約3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、休みは変わることがある、予約可 (10分遅れで取消)、原文で「418円（税込）」、32席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、法人会員。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): 2026年10月5日オープン、京鴨の焼きしゃぶ食べ放題 (上の鉄板で焼き、下の鍋でしゃぶしゃぶ)、5,980円、鴨むね・つくね・鍋野菜・十割そば付きで6,980円、飲み放題850円、鴨ロースの先付、鴨ユッケ、手羽、豚のコースも、九条ねぎのだし巻き、生麩、万願寺、フライドポテト、鴨だしのそばととろろ、防火扉の奥の隠れ家。

cultural_comfort.note: All-you-can-eat courses; ¥418 charge.

existence.note: Tabelog corporate-member listing; opened 5 October 2026, reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_obanzai_miroku_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura and kakiage, sweet-miso dishes, curry to finish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_obanzai_miroku_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai, sashimi, gizzards and beef tendon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_obanzai_miroku_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday, Monday and holidays. Reservations taken; change or cancel by the day before. 8 counter seats. Non-smoking. Cash only per Tabelog (no cards, e-money or QR). Ground floor of 第5雅会館 just off Tominaga-cho, Gion. Opened about December 2025 (a December 2025 reviewer found it newly opened).
kyoto_obanzai_miroku_gion.notes: [Obanzai & sake · off Tominaga-cho, Gion, a family-run eight-seat counter] A tiny, spotless counter run by sisters with family help, opening early by Gion standards: small plates of obanzai, tempura and oden, with a sake list picked by the sommelier son and prices reviewers call reasonable for the area. Cash only. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the counter is "run by sisters" (December 2025), with family now helping (January 2026), and that the sake is "made by the son, who is a sake sommelier" (July 2026). Reviewers praise warm conversation, reasonable Gion prices and the 5 pm opening; one December 2025 diner noted the menu was still short just after opening.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "Every time I go, I look forward to trying the unique Japanese sake they have in stock. The selections are made by the son, who is a sake sommelier."
October 2026: "They adjusted the sashimi assortment to a single serving for me, which I enjoyed with some Japanese sake."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おばんざい みろく、食堂・居酒屋、東山区祇園町北側347-67 第5雅会館、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、火〜土 17:00〜22:00、日・月・祝休み、予約可 (変更・取消は前日まで)、カウンター8席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 姉妹で営むおばんざいの店、家族も手伝う (2026年1月)、日本酒は利き酒師の息子が選ぶ (2026年7月)、20種以上の日本酒、少量のおばんざい、ほたるいかの甘味噌、れんこん団子、砂肝とにんにくの芽の炒め物、牛すじこんにゃく、アンチョビのポテサラ、おでん、海老としいたけの天ぷら、白えびのかき揚げ、ひとり分の刺身盛り、締めのご飯やカレー、瓶ビール3種 (エビス、サッポロラガー赤星)、祇園では手頃。

cultural_comfort.note: Eight-seat counter; cash only.

kyoto_sajiki_takoyakushi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: white-miso motsu-nabe with noodles to finish, karaage, fried nama-fu and fried ebi-imo (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sajiki_takoyakushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-offal hotpot, fish and duck dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sajiki_takoyakushi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sun and days before holidays 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Tuesday. Reservations taken; groups of 7+ by phone; no children under school age. 53 seats in private and semi-private rooms for 2–8, some on a loft floor with low beams (July 2025), and sunken round tables. Non-smoking. Cards; no e-money or QR. On Takoyakushi east of Takakura, north of Daimaru. A sister of Rokuhakuya (an August 2026 reviewer was redirected here when it was closed on a Monday).
kyoto_sajiki_takoyakushi.notes: [Izakaya · Takoyakushi-Takakura, private rooms and white-miso motsu-nabe] A late-opening izakaya of small private and loft rooms north of Daimaru, best for its Kyoto-style motsu-nabe in white miso, plus nodoguro, dashimaki and a good sake list. No young children. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists it as a corporate member; an August 2026 reviewer calls it the sister restaurant of Rokuhakuya. Reviewers from 2025 to 2026 praise the white-miso motsu-nabe, careful appetizers and quiet private rooms; one July 2025 guest kept hitting the low loft-floor beams, and one August 2025 group found its private room a little small.

anecdotes.text: March 2025: "The gentle flavor of the Kyoto white miso was delightful, and as it cooked, it developed a rich and robust taste that was delicious."
August 2025: "The dashimaki omelet in the photo is exactly as its name suggests; it's both a rolled omelet and a flavorful dashi dish."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 桟敷、居酒屋・魚介料理・もつ鍋、中京区蛸薬師通高倉東入ル雁金町364、地下鉄四条駅15番出口から徒歩5分、月・水〜日・祝前日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、火曜休み、予約可 (7名以上は電話)、未就学児不可、53席、個室・半個室 (2〜8名)、掘りごたつ、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、法人会員。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 京風の白味噌もつ鍋と締めの麺、飲み放題付きもつ鍋コース7品5,500円 (現金割引、2025年5月)、刺身、のどぐろの塩焼き、鱧の焼き物、鴨のチャーシュー、だし巻き各種、牛すじ豆腐、京もち豚と九条ねぎの炒め物、生麩の揚げ物、海老芋の揚げ物、唐揚げ、日本酒10種ほど、燗酒、サッポロ黒ラベル、Rokuhakuya の姉妹店 (2026年8月)、ロフト席の梁が低い (2025年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms; no children under school age.

kyoto_gionya_soba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, soba with soy-based dashi, tempura (2015–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gionya_soba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito dashi, herring, eel and shrimp (2015–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gionya_soba.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:00–15:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. Lunch only. Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR; a January 2023 reviewer paid by PayPay — bring cash to be safe. Non-smoking. English menu (May 2024). Roomy, with celebrity autographs on the walls (July 2023). On the north side of Shijo-dori in Gion, next to the former Gion Kagetsu (2020; 2023).
kyoto_gionya_soba.notes: [Soba & udon · Gion north side, a Showa-era lunch shop] A roomy old-school soba house by the former Gion Kagetsu theatre, its walls signed by comedians: nishin soba with sweet herring, kitsune or tempura udon in clear Kansai dashi, and chirimen-sansho rice. Some find it plain for the price. Lunch only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-established Gion soba and udon shop next to the former Gion Kagetsu, with autographs from Yoshimoto comedians and other celebrities on the walls (July 2023), clear Kansai broth and English menus. Criticism: "a bit high" prices (January 2023) and a zaru soba that was "just ordinary" with poor value (May 2023).

anecdotes.text: July 2023: "the walls were adorned with signatures from Yoshimoto comedians and other celebrities, giving it a well-known, esteemed atmosphere."
September 2025: "The soba was exquisite, but I was particularly moved by the sobayu (soba water)."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎおん家、そば、東山区祇園北側279、祇園四条から381m、月・火・木〜日 11:00〜15:00、水曜休み、時間は変わることがある、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2015年2月〜2025年9月、英語): 祇園の老舗のそば・うどん、昭和の雰囲気、旧祇園花月の隣、吉本の芸人などのサイン、英語のメニュー、にしんそば1,250円、ちりめん山椒ご飯、きつねうどん、ざるうどん、ざるそば、天ぷらうどん、うなぎ丼1,850円 (2023年1月)、そば湯、PayPay で支払い (2023年1月)、やや高め (2023年1月)、ざるそばは普通 (2023年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; lunch only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated June and September 2025.

kyoto_fresh_market_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan-grilled aged beef, pork and Kyoto vegetables are naturally wheat-free, but okonomiyaki and croutons share the griddle; no gluten information (2018–2025 reviews).
kyoto_fresh_market_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: aged beef, pork, sausages, homemade bacon and cheese omelette (2017–2025 reviews).
kyoto_fresh_market_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday, the day before and after a holiday 11:30–15:00 (last orders food 13:00, drinks 15:00) and 18:00–24:00 (food 22:00, drinks 24:00); Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (food 20:00) (Tabelog). Lunch by reservation only, by the day before (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats at the counter and sofas (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Bring your own wine for ¥5,000 a bottle, up to two guests per bottle (Tabelog). Children who can eat a course are welcome; dress appropriately (Tabelog). Sommelier on hand; take-away and delivery (Tabelog). 2F, 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 13 August 2004 (Tabelog).
kyoto_fresh_market_gion.notes: [Teppanyaki · Gion Kiyomoto-cho, 2F] A relaxed Gion teppan counter for dry-aged beef and Kyoto vegetables, cooked in front of you with a sommelier's wine list: start with the house-bacon salad and a truffle omelette under raclette, then aged strip loin or juicy Iwate pork; okonomiyaki too. Lunch by reservation only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppanyaki restaurant opened 13 August 2004 with a sommelier on staff. A May 2018 reviewer describes a casual owner holding a senior sommelier qualification, and wines at good prices.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 parent brought a teenage son for a birthday: the salad, an omelette with raclette for ¥500 more, and juicy Iwate pork; the parent finally tasted aged meat from Sakaeya.
A May 2018 guest at the counter had 53-day aged female kuroge wagyu from Kagoshima, simply salted, and chatted with the sommelier-owner.
An October 2019 diner called the raclette omelette with truffle the highlight.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ステーキ・牛料理・鉄板焼き、東山区清本町358-1 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝前日・祝後日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.料理13:00、ドリンク15:00)、18:00〜24:00 (料理22:00、ドリンク24:00)、日・祝 11:30〜15:00、18:00〜22:00 (料理20:00)、ランチは前日までの予約制、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、禁煙、ワインの持ち込みは1本5,000円 (1本につき2名まで)、コースを食べられる子どもは可、ふさわしい服装で、ソムリエあり、テイクアウト・デリバリー、2004年8月13日開店。口コミ (2017年11月〜2025年12月、英語): 熟成肉の鉄板焼き、鹿児島の黒毛和牛の雌53日熟成、Sakaeya の熟成肉、ストリップロイン、岩手の豚、バスク豚、自家製ベーコンの京野菜サラダ、ラクレットとトリュフのオムレツ (ラクレット +500円)、お好み焼き、ソーセージ、シニアソムリエのオーナー (2018年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter teppanyaki; lunch by reservation; BYO wine ¥5,000; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; latest review December 2025.

kyoto_rakuza_hareruya.gf_detail: Not GF: fried oysters, corn tempura, karaage, udon to finish and soy-based oden (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakuza_hareruya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi oden, fish and seafood (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakuza_hareruya.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closing days irregular — see Instagram or Google (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; on the day, cancelling a course costs 100% and a seat-only booking ¥5,000 per person (Tabelog). Charge ¥550 incl. tax (Tabelog original チャージ料金：550円（税込み）). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 55 seats: 13 at the counter downstairs, 12 at tables, 30 at sunken-kotatsu tables upstairs; groups to 26 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Non-smoking; smoking area outside (Tabelog). Children welcome; ask about bringing drinks (Tabelog). On Takakura above Nishikikoji, behind Daimaru; 3 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 11 January 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rakuza_hareruya.notes: [Oden izakaya · Takakura behind Daimaru] A friendly two-floor izakaya that serves oden all year: a counter downstairs and sunken-kotatsu tables upstairs for groups, with oden-broth potato salad, saba oshizushi, sashimi and obanzai, and an all-you-can-drink sake course. ¥550 charge. One October 2026 guest found the seafood below par.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya of oden, sushi and Kyoto food opened 11 January 2021 on Takakura, with counter, table and sunken-kotatsu seating across two floors. Reviewers in 2026 praise the owner and staff's service.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular loves that oden is served even in summer and calls the oden-potato-and-egg salad a must.
A June 2026 work party of eight, booked by a regular, let the chef choose and was sent obanzai, sashimi, oden, karaage and husk-grilled young corn.
An October 2026 diner found the seafood and seafood salad lacking freshness, wondering if it was an off day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・寿司・おでん、中京区高倉通錦小路上る貝屋町568、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、不定休 (Instagram・Google で告知)、予約可、当日のキャンセルはコース100%・席のみ1人5,000円、チャージ550円 (税込)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、55席 (カウンター13、テーブル12、掘りごたつ30)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、子ども可、飲み物の持ち込みは相談、2021年1月11日開店。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月、英語): 大丸の裏、夏もおでん、おでんのじゃがいもと卵のポテトサラダ、鯖の押し寿司、だし巻き、鯛のかま焼き、刺身盛り2人前2,750円、とうもろこしの天ぷら825円、おでん220〜275円、お通し550円、牡蠣フライ、蒸し鶏のサラダ、おばんざい、締めはうどんか雑炊、純米大吟醸も飲み放題の青天家コース、2階は掘りごたつ、魚介の鮮度がいまひとつとの声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥550 charge; same-day cancellation fees; cards and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_kichikazu_gion.gf_detail: Ask. A small izakaya with a beef shabu-shabu course; no menu or gluten information in the sources (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kichikazu_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef shabu-shabu and fish roe (2016; March 2025).
kyoto_kichikazu_gion.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–3:00, open all year (Tabelog; October 2022). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). An appetizer is served and charged (Tabelog original お通しあり). 15 seats: 7 at the counter and a sunken-kotatsu tatami room of 8 for 4–6 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Run by one man (October 2022; March 2025). Down an alley on the north side of Gion; 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; March 2025).
kyoto_kichikazu_gion.notes: [Izakaya · Gion north side, 6 p.m.–3 a.m., every day] A tiny Showa-era izakaya down a Gion alley, run single-handed by a master who opens every night of the year until 3 a.m.: a counter for conversation and a small sunken-kotatsu room, with beef shabu-shabu by course. Many regulars. Cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a small Gion izakaya with Showa-era charm run solely by its master, open from 18:00 to 3:00 every day of the year (October 2022), with many regulars (March 2025). A December 2023 reviewer comes to see the head chef rather than for the food.

anecdotes.text: An October 2022 visitor marvelled that the master runs it alone and opens every day of the year, 18:00 to 3:00.
A March 2025 guest found the alley shop full of regulars yet quiet enough to relax at the counter over a beef shabu-shabu course.
A September 2023 reviewer liked how the master keeps a comfortable distance, good for relaxed talk at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、東山区祇園町北側347-127、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、毎日 18:00〜翌3:00、年中無休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、お通しあり、15席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつの座敷8・4〜6名の個室)、喫煙可、日本酒・焼酎・ワイン。口コミ (2016年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 昭和の雰囲気の小さな店、店主が一人で営む、年中無休で18時から3時まで (2022年10月)、常連が多い、牛しゃぶのコース (2025年3月)、店主との距離感がよい (2023年9月)、きれい好きには向かないとの声 (2023年12月)、2023年11月〜2026年9月に12回通う常連。

cultural_comfort.note: One-man counter of regulars; cash only; appetizer charged; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; a regular's visits logged through September 2026.

kyoto_kyo_ajiwa.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki courses change daily; Tabelog asks guests to note allergies when booking. No gluten information (Tabelog; 2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_ajiwa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi, fish and Kirishima beef courses (Tabelog; 2022–2024 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_ajiwa.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed 25 December–1 January; lunch kaiseki and closing-day bookings by phone or email (Tabelog). Reservation only; note allergies when booking; same-day bookings by phone (Tabelog). Service charge 5% (Tabelog original サービス料5%). Cancellation 50% three days before, 80% two days, 100% the day before or on the day (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: 4 at the counter and 3 private rooms for 2–10 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome; children's meals ¥3,300 and ¥5,500 by advance booking (Tabelog). A Miyagawa-cho back alley; 6 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn, near Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog; October 2024). Opened 18 March 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_ajiwa.notes: [Kaiseki · Miyagawa-cho alley] A quiet kaiseki house down a Miyagawa-cho alley with a four-seat counter and three private rooms: seasonal courses from ¥9,800 and Kirishima beef kaiseki, sukiyaki or shabu-shabu. Courses change daily; children's meals by arrangement. Reservation only; 5% service charge.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant opened 18 March 2022 near Kiyomizu-dera and Otani Honbyo, offering kaiseki and Kirishima beef courses with counter and private rooms. An October 2024 reviewer says it was listed as a Michelin Guide selection for 2024 and describes a veteran chef chatting across the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Traditional Japanese cuisine in a relaxed setting (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A November 2022 party of four in kimono could not finish the bamboo-shoot rice and had it made into onigiri to take away.
An October 2024 pair had the counter to themselves as the veteran chef talked between courses — salmon tartare on potato chips, matsutake dobin-mushi.
A December 2023 guest was seen off by a maiko on the way out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮、東山区西御門町455-2、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩6分、毎日 17:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、12月25日〜1月1日休み、昼の懐石や休業日の予約は電話かメールで、完全予約制、アレルギーは予約時に、サービス料5%、キャンセル料 (3日前50%、2日前80%、前日・当日100%)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、18席 (カウンター4、個室3室2〜10名)、禁煙、子ども可 (お子様料理3,300円・5,500円、要予約)、2022年3月18日開店、清水寺や Otani Honbyo に近い、懐石9,800円・15,000円、Kirishima 牛の懐石18,900円、すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ23,000円 (税込)、記念日のホールケーキ5,000円。口コミ (2022年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 宮川町の路地、2024年のミシュランガイド掲載との声、ベテランの料理人がカウンターで話す、まぐろ、Kirishima 牛の白味噌の椀、ポテトチップスにのせた鮭のタルタル、松茸と鱧の土瓶蒸し、鰆や中とろの刺身、まぐろの煮物、甘海老の寿司、筍ご飯を持ち帰りのおにぎりに (2022年11月)、帰りに舞妓の見送り (2023年12月)、静かで品数が多い (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; 5% service charge; private rooms; children's meals by arrangement; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_gion_shugetsu_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-based arare and okaki, but seasonings often include soy sauce (wheat), and some crackers contain shrimp or sesame (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shugetsu_honten.vegan_detail: Ask. Rice crackers, but shrimp senbei and dashi or other seasonings may be animal-based (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shugetsu_honten.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–18:00 (Tabelog); the shop's Rakuten store says the Gion main shop closes on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money (Tabelog). A takeaway shop; also sold online and through department-store counters (own site; August 2026 review). South of Shijo in Gion (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_shugetsu_honten.notes: [Arare & senbei · Gion] The Gion main shop of a Kyoto rice-cracker maker that supplies Gion tea houses and restaurants: light, individually wrapped arare, senbei and okaki in pretty assortments from about ¥1,000 — a long-keeping Kyoto gift.

chef_bio.background: A Kyoto arare specialist whose crackers are used by Gion tea houses and well-known Kyoto restaurants (Tabelog). Run by Syugetsu Corporation (own site).
chef_bio.specialty: Individually wrapped arare and okaki assortments.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 regular buys here for gifts and memorial offerings: light, long-keeping, individually wrapped and, at about ¥1,000 an assortment, without price rises.
A May 2026 buyer of the Sagano assortment liked the fluffy kinako mochi best.
A December 2025 recipient of a small bag found it like a lucky dip of arare and senbei in Kyoto-style packaging.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京あられ 京都祇園萩月本店、和菓子、東山区祇園町南側573-7、毎日 11:00〜18:00 (変更の可能性あり)、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー可、祇園のお茶屋や京料理の名店が使う京あられの専門店。楽天市場の萩月: 祇園本店は火曜・水曜定休。公式サイト (Syugetsu Corporation): 花かりん、花あわせ、祇園セット、雅び焼、鞍馬焼き。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語、多くは贈答品): Sagano の詰め合わせ、えびせん、きな粉餅、黒ごまのせんべい、白えびのせんべい、かりんとうのような甘いあられ、個包装で日持ちする、1,000円ほどの詰め合わせ、デパートにも出店。

cultural_comfort.note: Shop counter; packaged gifts.

existence.note: Tabelog listing, own site and Rakuten store; reviews dated through November 2026 (most about gifts received).

kyoto_gion_tanimoto.gf_detail: Ask. A dashi-led Kyoto kaiseki; soy sauce and fried courses are likely (2021–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tanimoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout, fish, hamo, ayu, crab, soft-shelled turtle (2021–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tanimoto.hours_raw: Mon 17:30–22:00; Tue–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sundays (Tabelog). Bookings advised (November 2024 review). 10% service charge in private rooms only (Tabelog Japanese original 「個室のみ10％頂戴しております。」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: a 10-seat counter downstairs and two private rooms upstairs; smoking only in the private rooms (Tabelog). Off Hanamikoji in south Gion, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; November 2024 review).
kyoto_gion_tanimoto.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Gion] A small, unpretentious Gion kappo with a counter and two upstairs rooms, serving traditional, lightly modern Kyoto kaiseki around careful dashi — hamo, ayu, turtle, crab by season — with a warm chef. Lunch about ¥6,000–8,000; dinner ¥15,000–20,000.

chef_bio.background: Reviewed on Tabelog since 2008. A counter with the owner and proprietress greeting guests (November 2021 review); two kitchen staff and a server at a quiet lunch (October 2023 review). Reviewers praise the friendly, unpretentious chef and the dashi (2023–2025 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Faithful, traditional kaiseki, lightly modernised, built on dashi (2023 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner sent by a gourmet friend remembered the warmth of the chef and staff most; the night in Gion flew by.
An August 2023 first-timer at a kaiseki restaurant had hamo with plum and Kamo River ayu, and took a photo with the friendly head chef.
A November 2024 diner walked 30 minutes from the Kyoto National Museum, turned off busy Hanamikoji, and found warm dishes as the weather turned cold.
An April 2024 business dinner was served a soft-shelled turtle hot pot with no off smell.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 たに本、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-121、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月 17:30〜22:00、火〜土・祝 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜22:00、日曜休み、個室のみサービス料10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、22席 (1階カウンター10、2階個室2)、喫煙は個室のみ。口コミ (2021〜2025年、英語): 出汁を生かした京の会席、大根と kinshi tamago、ebi shinjo、matsukaze-yaki、にしん、若鮎、Seto Inland Sea の鯛、鱧の梅、Kamo River の鮎、いくら、すっぽんの鍋、かにと湯葉と水菜、にしんの甘煮、気さくな料理長、昼6,000〜8,000円、夜15,000〜20,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter kaiseki; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through December 2025.

kyoto_kyosaien_hanamikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak may suit, but sauces, garlic-butter rice and appetizers are unknown (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyosaien_hanamikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kobe and other wagyu steak, wagyu shabu-shabu and kakuni, tuna yukke (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyosaien_hanamikoji.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「10%のサービス料を承ります。」). Cards and e-money; cashless only (Tabelog; March 2026 review). 23 seats: two counters around the teppan and a private VIP room with its own teppan (Tabelog; May 2026 review). 2nd floor of the 井澤ビル on Shijo, near Hanamikoji, 3–5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; Gurunavi; June 2026 review).
kyoto_kyosaien_hanamikoji.notes: [Kobe beef teppanyaki · Gion] A second-floor teppanyaki on Shijo by Hanamikoji, run by a Kobe company of about 50 years, with counter seats around the grill and a private teppan room: flambéed Kobe and Tajima beef at dinner, and a ¥4,500 wagyu steak box or bowl at lunch. 10% service; cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 September 2024 (Tabelog) by a long-established Kobe company of about 50 years (Tabelog; Gurunavi says 47). A sister shop, 京彩宴 祇園店, is nearby at 祇園町北側263 (Gurunavi). Chefs trained in high-end hotels and abroad (June 2026 review); a charming manager with stories from the trade (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kobe beef meeting strict certification, in an elegant setting for special occasions (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 birthday diner, nervous at a first teppanyaki, found the chefs entertaining and was surprised with a dessert plate.
A May 2026 lunch diner had the Hanamikoji-only 100 g wagyu steak box for ¥4,500 and learned lunch uses Hokkaido Saroma beef to keep the price down.
A June 2026 lunch diner liked the flambé and garlic-butter rice but did not find the ¥4,500 bowl an overwhelming bargain.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 神戸牛 鉄板焼 京彩宴 花見小路店、ステーキ・鉄板焼き、東山区祇園町北側266 井澤ビル2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜21:00、サービス料10%、カード・電子マネー可、23席、個室、2024年9月6日オープン、神戸で約50年の老舗企業が祇園で神戸牛 (紹介文、英訳)。ぐるなび: 神戸で47年愛された企業、姉妹店の京彩宴 祇園店 (祇園町北側263)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夜は Kobe Usunaga Farm の Tajima beef、昼は Hokkaido の Saroma beef、和牛ステーキのボックス100g 4,500円、黒毛和牛ステーキ丼100g 4,500円、和牛しゃぶしゃぶ・角煮・まぐろのユッケの前菜、フランベ、ガーリックバター、キャッシュレスのみ、誕生日のデザートプレート。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter teppanyaki; private room.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_kyosaien_hanamikoji.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26041979/ (35.004068, 135.774852), 1.4 m from kyoto_da_ciro and 6.0 m from kyoto_kani_iroha_gion (same 井澤ビル) — moved 5 m west-south-west to (35.004051, 135.774801), 6.2 m clearance; cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側266番地 (lot) 10m; 2026-11-07

kyoto_bistro_bleecker.gf_detail: Ask. Sliders, fritters, salmon cakes and brownies are wheat; salads and grilled chicken may suit (2025 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_bleecker.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pulled pork, grilled chicken, salmon cakes, crème brûlée (2025 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_bleecker.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 17:30–22:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (Tabelog; own site). Bookings taken; groups by phone (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 18 seats; non-smoking indoors, smoking on the outdoor terrace; wheelchair accessible; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). On Bukkoji west of Yanagibamba, 5 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_bistro_bleecker.notes: [New York bistro · Shijo-Karasuma] A calm 18-seat bistro on Bukkoji run by a chef with a New York career, cooking American bistro dishes — sliders, corn fritters, salmon cakes with dill, brownies — with seasonal Japanese produce. About ¥4,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 October 2022 (Tabelog). The chef is named on the restaurant's own site. A March 2026 reviewer writes that the chef was the first female sous-chef at Le Cirque in Manhattan, cooking for celebrities including Bill Clinton, and assisted pastry chef Jacques Torres on television cooking shows. A female owner looked after a June 2025 diner.
chef_bio.philosophy: "You are what you eat": gentle seasoning that lets seasonal Japanese ingredients show (March 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 first-timer worked through pulled-pork sliders, corn fritters, grilled chicken and brownies, with homemade lemonade and mint-heavy mojitos.
A November 2025 group dinner almost ordered the salmon cakes again just for the dill sauce.
A March 2026 diner came with high expectations because of the chef's New York career and found food that "makes your body happy".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Bistro Bleecker、アメリカ料理・ビストロ・バル、下京区仏光寺通柳馬場西入東前町405、四条駅から徒歩5分、水〜日 17:30〜22:00、月・火休み、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、18席、禁煙 (屋外テラスは喫煙可)、車いす可、英語メニュー、子ども可、2022年10月1日オープン。公式サイト: NYスタイルビストロ、浅田ひろこ、17:30〜22:00、月・火定休。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): プルドポークのスライダー、ビーツの前菜、コーンフリッター、グリルチキン、ブラウニー、自家製レモネードとモヒート、ディルソースのサーモンケーキ、フルーツのサラダ、クレームブリュレ、シェフは Le Cirque (Manhattan) で女性初のスーシェフだったと口コミ (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); chef with a New York career (March 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_kappa_zushi_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi ordered by the piece, sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, tempura; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kappa_zushi_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and fish restaurant (Tabelog).
kyoto_kappa_zushi_pontocho.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sunday and holidays also 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). ¥418 appetizer charge a person (Tabelog). 87 seats over two floors: counters where you watch the chefs, and sunken horigotatsu seating; non-smoking; a Kamo River noryo-yuka from May, with a course menu (Tabelog; June 2026). Many foreign guests (2026 reviews). Not related to the national conveyor-belt chain of the same name — run by the Kyoto company 黛 (Tabelog website link; suishin.co.jp). On Pontocho north of Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_kappa_zushi_pontocho.notes: [Sushi · Pontocho, an old-school Edomae house on the Kamo] A busy two-floor sushi house on Pontocho — not the conveyor chain — serving Edomae nigiri by the piece for over 40 years, at prices that are reasonable for the street. Watch the chefs from the counter, or book the summer yuka over the Kamo for a sushi course. Open daily; lunch on Sundays.

chef_bio.background: The shop says it has run a sushi restaurant in Pontocho for over 40 years, serving Edomae sushi from skilled chefs at fair prices (Tabelog). Its Tabelog website link is suishin.co.jp, the site of 黛 (Mayuzumi), a Kyoto company founded in Pontocho in 1969 that runs about 18 shops, mostly in Kyoto, including 先斗町すいしん.
chef_bio.philosophy: Orthodox dishes made better than anywhere, cooked in each shop by two to eight craftsmen (黛 company site).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 party rained off the yuka was moved to a window seat over the river and allowed to switch from the course to a la carte.
A June 2026 diner had a yuka sushi course with views of Shijo Bridge and Minami-za, despite a swollen river.
A January 2026 returnee finished a long sushi run with a bowl of fish-head soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かっぱ寿司、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、京都市中京区先斗町四条上ル松本町160 栞ビル1F、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日祝 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜23:00、年中無休、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、お通し代1人税込418円、87席、禁煙、1階・2階にカウンターと掘りごたつ、5月から鴨川納涼床、先斗町で40年以上の寿司店、職人の江戸前寿司をお手頃に、ウェブサイトは suishin.co.jp (黛: 昭和44年に先斗町で創業、京都を中心に18店舗)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 1貫ずつ注文、中トロ、鰻、いくら、ひらめ、甘海老、帆立、鉄火巻、刺身盛り合わせ、鯛の昆布締めと煮付け、むつの西京焼き、鮎の塩焼き、筍の天ぷら、あら汁、床のコース、外国からの客が多い、1人2,000〜8,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Many foreign guests; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_inaho_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Hokkaido seafood — sashimi, crab, grilled fish, butter-sautéed clams — plus jingisukan and oden; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_inaho_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Hokkaido seafood and lamb (Tabelog).
kyoto_inaho_gion.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00 Monday–Saturday (last orders around 21:00); closed Sunday and over New Year (Tabelog; April 2024). Reservations taken. Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥500–600 (Tabelog). 19 seats: 7 at the counter and a 12-seat tatami room; smoking allowed; no one under 20 (Tabelog). Choose from the day’s fish in the showcase; dishes beyond the menu on request (Tabelog). Down an alley off Yamato-oji south of Shijo, near Minami-za, 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; December 2024).
kyoto_inaho_gion.notes: [Hokkaido seafood · Gion, a one-woman alley izakaya] A tiny 19-seat izakaya down an alley by Minami-za, run single-handed by an owner from Sapporo who brings in Hokkaido fish direct — kinki, surf clam, hairy and king crab, herring — plus jingisukan and Hokkaido sake. Pick from the showcase. Smoking allowed; over-20s only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2023–2025) describe a small Gion izakaya run entirely by its owner, a woman from Sapporo, who sources seafood directly from Hokkaido; one saw it featured on Yomiuri TV.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 guest was given seasoned-rice inari sushi to take home and ate it for breakfast.
A March 2026 regular, on a mother’s tip, had sake poured into the emptied baked crab shell to warm it.
A January 2025 diner came after the New Year show at Minami-za and a visit to Seimei Shrine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: いなほ、海鮮・居酒屋・日本料理、京都市東山区大和町18-17、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩4分、月〜土 17:30〜22:00、日曜定休、年末年始休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー不可、お通し500〜600円、19席 (座敷12、カウンター7)、喫煙可、20歳未満入店不可、北海道直送の鮮魚とジンギスカン、ショーケースから本日のおすすめを選べる、北海道の地酒、インボイス T3810496895799。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 札幌出身の店主がひとりで切り盛り、路地の奥、キンキと活ホッキ貝の刺身、タラバガニ・花咲ガニ・毛蟹、秋はニシンやホッケの刺身、子持ちニシン焼き、ジンギスカン、カジカ汁、鮭のいずし、いくらと明太子のご飯、白子焼き、ホッキのバター焼き、甲羅焼きに日本酒、いなり寿司のお土産、読売テレビで紹介、1人1万〜1万2千円ほど (2021年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny counter; smoking allowed; over-20s only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_izakaya_kaisen_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, grilled and simmered fish, fried fish; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_kaisen_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-only izakaya with few vegetable dishes (reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_kaisen_kawaramachi.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Wednesday and some other days; may close early when ingredients run out (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service, cover or seat charge (Tabelog). 22 seats at the counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2025). Food can be slow when busy — the owner often cooks alone (Tabelog; January and February 2025). On the 2nd floor of the Nagayoshi Building, south of Sanjo on Kawaramachi, 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_izakaya_kaisen_kawaramachi.notes: [Fish izakaya · Kawaramachi near Sanjo, sashimi and sake] A no-frills second-floor fish bar buying daily at Kyoto's central market, with sashimi from ¥500, a big sashimi boat for under ¥3,000 and about 50 sakes from ¥500 — weekday all-you-can-drink sake too. The owner cooks, so it can be slow when full. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in September 2012 (Tabelog). The shop says it goes to Kyoto Central Wholesale Market itself and keeps labour and décor costs low to put the money into fish (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025) describe the owner cooking alone with newly hired staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshness and flavour first; you have to see the fish yourself, so it is bought direct at the market (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 pair sat by the kitchen, where the busy owner still found time to recommend sakes.
A March 2024 first-timer came back the next week for the clam-filled asparagus rice.
An October 2026 diner found five kinds, shellfish included, on a great-value sashimi platter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮、居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、京都市中京区北車屋町276 永吉ビル2F、河原町駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜24:00 (L.O.フード23:00、ドリンク23:30)、水曜定休、臨時休業あり、材料がなくなり次第早じまいも、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料・突き出し料・席料なし、22席、喫煙可、2012年9月6日オープン、京都中央卸売市場で直接仕入れ、人件費と内装を抑えて魚に、刺身500円から、生ビール500円から、日本酒500円から、純米大吟醸や而今、鍋島、伯楽星など約50種。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 舟盛り2,400〜2,800円、カマ焼き、ぶり大根、昆布締め、あんこうの唐揚げ、あさりたっぷりのアスパラご飯、十四代、平日のみ日本酒飲み放題2,640円、店主がひとりで調理、混むと料理が遅い。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated through October 2026.
