kyoto_the_sakura_gion.gf_detail: Ask. French courses with Japanese seasonings such as miso and soy sauce, ending in a grilled rice-ball dashi chazuke; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_the_sakura_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, wagyu, duck and shark fin (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_the_sakura_gion.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (food last order 13:00); dinner 17:30–21:30 (food last order 20:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 28 seats: counter by an open kitchen, tables, and private rooms with a view of Minami-za; non-smoking; skylights (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Eaten with chopsticks throughout (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the 4th floor of the Shimaya Building on Shijo, next to Minami-za, a short walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_the_sakura_gion.notes: [French · Gion by Minami-za, French with chopsticks] A new fourth-floor restaurant next to Minami-za serving French courses with Japanese seasonings, all eaten with chopsticks — charcoal-grilled wagyu from the open kitchen and a dashi chazuke to finish. Lunch courses; dinner from ¥13,000 with paired wine. Private rooms look onto Minami-za. 10% service; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in 2026 (reviews from June 2026). Run by 株式会社ファーマフーズ of Nishikyo, Kyoto (National Tax Agency invoice register T5130001011549). The shop’s motto is "bringing French cuisine closer", with traditional techniques and a hint of Japanese flavour, eaten with chopsticks (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring French cuisine closer: traditional French techniques with subtle Japanese flavours, eaten with chopsticks (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled wagyu; grilled rice-ball dashi chazuke to close the course.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest was surprised when hot dashi was poured over grilled rice balls at the table to end a French course.
A June 2026 diner lifted a glass dome to release cherry-wood smoke over a soft-boiled egg.
An October 2026 business dinner had a private room with a glimpse of Minami-za.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: The Sakura、フレンチ・洋食・創作料理、京都市東山区四条通大和大路西入中之町206 志満家ビル4F、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O.料理13:00)、夜17:30〜21:30 (L.O.料理20:00)、水曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、サービス料10%、28席 (個室、カウンター、テーブル)、禁煙、お箸で食べるフレンチ、「フレンチをもっと身近に」、伝統の技法に和の風味、ワインと日本酒、ペアリングコース13,000円、スペシャルコース「つぼみ」 (京都姫牛のフィレなど10品) 17,500円、インボイス T5130001011549 (株式会社ファーマフーズ、京都市西京区)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 南座の隣、天窓、オープンキッチン、鴨川コースのランチ (桜チップで燻した半熟卵、鰹のカルパッチョ、魚のポワレ、和牛ミスジの炭火焼き、焼きおにぎりの出汁茶漬け)、フカヒレ、ロッシーニ、伊勢海老のスペシャルコース33,000円、個室から南座。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; chopsticks throughout; 10% service.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog official listing; reviews dated June–October 2026.

kyoto_mother_india_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Curries with naan or rice and biryani; naan is wheat, and nothing is said about thickeners or a gluten-free option (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_mother_india_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. 28 curries include dal makhani, but no vegan dishes are named and butter and cream are common in the curries (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_mother_india_kawaramachi.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 daily (lunch to 15:00); closing days may vary (Tabelog). Cards and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog); an August 2025 reviewer found it cash-only at the time. 40 seats at tables and sofas (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the 4th floor of ヒジカタビル on Kawaramachi, above Tribute Coffee, 5 min from Sanjo (Tabelog; August 2025). Opened 25 August 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mother_india_kawaramachi.notes: [Indian curry · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, 4th floor] A roomy fourth-floor Indian restaurant over Kawaramachi with 28 curries at five spice levels, a much-ordered cheese-naan lunch, mutton biryani, lassi and Indian beer, open all day till 11 pm. Flagged: Tokyo has a MOTHER INDIA chain; a link to this shop is not established.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe friendly staff (December 2025, March 2026) from India, with some language barrier (June 2026). Tabelog’s name search shows MOTHER INDIA shops in Tokyo; this shop lists no invoice number and its operator was not found.
chef_bio.specialty: Cheese naan lunch; butter chicken curry.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner expected a thin layer of cheese and got a naan so thick that half would have been enough.
An August 2025 visitor recommends a table looking out at the church, as the window side warms up in the afternoon sun.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: RESTAURANT＆Bar MOTHER INDIA、インドカレー・タイ料理・ネパール料理、中京区恵比須町435-2 ヒジカタビル 4F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩4分、毎日 11:00〜15:00、15:00〜23:00、不定休、カード・QR可、40席、禁煙、2025年8月25日オープン、28種のカレー、辛さを選べる、ナンかライス、ラッシー、生ビール、飲み放題。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 日替わりカレーのランチ890円、チーズナンランチ1,250円、ナンのおかわり150円、バターチキン、茄子とチキンのカレー、マトンビリヤニ、マンゴージュース、インドとタイのビール、インド出身のスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Indian staff; some language gaps reported (June 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_gion_ashida.gf_detail: Ask. Suppon and eel courses: eel sashimi with plum and wasabi, eel hot pot, kabayaki and an eel bowl, suppon hot pot; no gluten information (own site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ashida.vegan_detail: Not vegan: suppon, eel, fugu and hamo courses (own site).
kyoto_gion_ashida.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); Sunday by reservation only; closed on public holidays (own site). Tabelog lists Monday–Saturday 18:00–22:00 and Sunday 18:30–21:00 — the shop’s own hours are used. Book early by phone; seats fill for banquets (Tabelog). Cards and QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 5 at the counter and two tatami rooms (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A tank of live suppon at the door and eels inside (2026 reviews). Down a back alley in Gion (切り通し), just east of Shijo-Hanamikoji, 8 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (own site; April 2026). Opened 1992 (own site).
kyoto_gion_ashida.notes: [Suppon and eel · Gion 切り通し, since 1992] A 16-seat back-alley shop with a tank of live suppon at the door, where the Kyoto-born owner prepares suppon and eel at the counter: a two-eel course of eel sashimi, hot pot, kabayaki and a mini bowl (¥12,000), the suppon course for two (¥19,000), and hamo with matsutake in autumn. Sunday by reservation; closed on holidays.

chef_bio.background: Born and raised in Kyoto, the owner went to work at a restaurant after high school and opened ぎをん蘆田 at 切り通し in 1992 (own site). Reviewers describe a friendly master who chats while preparing the fish (July and August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 first-timer watched a companion scoop a suppon from the tank and hand it to the master, who prepared it on the spot.
An October 2026 regular found matsutake already in the hamo-shabu hot pot, earlier than expected.
The shop’s site announced a 5–25 November suppon course for about two at ¥13,000 instead of ¥19,000, the same price for three, adding 男子、カップルごめんなさい — not for men or couples.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぎをん蘆田 すっぽん うなぎ料理、京都に生まれ育ち、高校卒業後に料理店で働き、1992年に切り通しで開店、東山区祇園町北側347-92 双葉ビル一階、18:00〜23:00 (LO22:30)、祝祭日定休、日曜日は予約のみ、名物すっぽんコース (2名分) 19,000円、鰻2匹コース12,000円、うなぎ1匹丼6,000円、うなぎ1匹コース6,500円、フグ1匹コース (二人前) 21,000円、季節特別松茸ハモしゃぶコース (2人分) 21,000円、11月5日〜25日限定ですっぽん1匹コース13,000円 (男子、カップルごめんなさい)。食べログ: 愛知と佐賀から直送のすっぽんと鰻、目の前でさばく、16席、禁煙、1992年3月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 入口の水槽のすっぽん、三河一色の鰻、湯引きを梅とわさびで、鰻鍋、白焼き、蒲焼き、肝焼き、う巻き、ミニ鰻丼、すっぽんの生き血をりんごジュースで、鱧と松茸のコース、気さくな大将。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter and tatami rooms; book by phone.

existence.note: Own site with a November 2026 offer; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_mabrur_halal_dining.gf_detail: Ask. Curries with tandoor naan or rice, biryani, kebab plates and samosa; no gluten information (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_mabrur_halal_dining.vegan_detail: Ask. Five curries a day at lunch, but no vegan dish is named; the menu centres on chicken, mutton and shrimp (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_mabrur_halal_dining.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 12:00–22:30, Friday 16:00–22:30, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00) (Tabelog). Lunch menu until 15:30 (March 2025). Reservations by phone or WhatsApp (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). 45 seats in large booths (Tabelog; March 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Halal, with no alcohol and a prayer space (own site; February and June 2026). On the 2nd floor of 御所飴ビル on Sanjo, up a narrow stair, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; March 2025). Moved here from behind Kawaramachi OPA (Tabelog).
kyoto_mabrur_halal_dining.notes: [Halal curry and biryani · Sanjo, by the bridge] A roomy second-floor halal restaurant just west of Sanjo bridge, with a prayer space and no alcohol: Bangladeshi and Indian curries with tandoor naan, generous biryani, and Middle-Eastern mutton and chicken kebabs, from a ¥980 curry lunch. The kitchen uses no nuts anywhere on the menu. Spice adjusted to taste.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site describes chefs bringing together Bangladeshi and Indian curry and biryani with Middle-Eastern kebabs, and explains halal as Islamic food rules that anyone can eat safely. Staff explain dishes in Japanese and English (May 2026). Several reviewers note many overseas or Muslim guests (April and May 2025, May and October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Halal food that non-Muslim guests can enjoy just as safely; spice adjusted for everyone (own site).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular has come for the biryani on every Kyoto stay for four years, though a Bengali partner found it mild.
A May 2025 diner was struck by a sign at the till saying those without money need not pay.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: MABRUR HALAL DINING KYOTO (マブルーハラルダイニング京都)、京都三条駅すぐのバングラデシュ・インド料理、バングラデシュ・インドのカレーとビリヤニ、中東のケバブ、ハラルはイスラム教の食の基準だがイスラム教以外の人も安全に食べられる、メニュー全体でナッツ類を使用しない、カレーランチセット980円 (税込) から、5種から選べるカレー、辛さ調整可、サラダ・スープ付き、名物のタンドリーチキンランチセット、チキン・マトン・エビのケバブプレート。食べログ: インド料理、中京区中島町98 御所飴ビル 2F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、月〜木 12:00〜22:30、金 16:00〜22:30、土日祝 11:30〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、45席、禁煙、河原町OPA裏から移転。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): アルコールなし、礼拝スペース、チキンビリヤニ、アフガンマトンビリヤニ、カブリプラオ、サモサ、バターチキン、海外やムスリムのお客が多い、日本語と英語で説明。

cultural_comfort.note: Dishes explained in Japanese and English (May 2026); halal, no alcohol; reservations by phone or WhatsApp.

staff_allergy_handling: The shop says it has removed nuts from the whole menu — biryani, curry and naan included — for guests with nut allergies (own site).

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_drink_drank_rokkaku.gf_detail: Ask. Fruit smoothies and juices are the core, but panini are baked on site (May 2026); no gluten information.
kyoto_drink_drank_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Ask. Some smoothies use milk (June 2026), but the peach smoothie was recommended as non-dairy (July 2026) and the mixed juice can be made without milk or sugar (August 2026); panini have mozzarella (May 2026).
kyoto_drink_drank_rokkaku.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–18:00; closing days may vary (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Takeaway, with standing room inside for 2–3 and a park across the street (Tabelog; May 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor on Rokkaku-dori, facing a park, in the former Hananoki Sandwich shop (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 1 May 2026 (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_drink_drank_rokkaku.notes: [Fruit smoothies · Rokkaku-dori, since May 2026] The Kyoto Rokkaku-dori shop of a Nara smoothie specialist founded in 1999: thick, spoonable smoothies of seasonal fruit — peach, melon, dekopon, persimmon — piled with fresh chunks, plus juices and hot-pressed panini. Mostly takeaway, with a park across the street. Ask for no milk or sugar.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and 2026 reviews: DRINK DRANK began in Nara in 1999, after the founder fell for smoothies abroad; a Kiyomizu Sanneizaka shop followed about five years ago and this Rokkaku-dori shop opened on 1 May 2026. Fruit comes directly from growers.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fruit delivered straight from farmers, carefully prepared, one cup at a time (official site).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 passer-by was drawn in by two boxes of peaches on display outside.
An August 2026 visitor watched the white peaches being peeled after ordering.
A July 2026 visitor was told the peaches that day came from Wakayama, with sources changing through the season.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: ジューススタンド・スムージー専門店、中京区大黒町88 シルブプレビル 1F、毎日11:00〜18:00、不定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、立ち飲みのスペース、テイクアウト、禁煙、2026年5月1日オープン、1999年に奈良で創業、産地の農家から直接届く果物。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): パニーニ650円、スムージー750〜880円、ジュース600〜700円、デコポン、スイカ、メロン、梅、白桃のスムージー880円、柿のスムージー880円、ミックスジュースは牛乳と砂糖を抜ける、公園の前。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the fruit on display; takeaway counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_cloud10_pub.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fish and chips, pizza, meatball bolognese (official site; 2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_cloud10_pub.vegan_detail: Ask. A pub: fries, nuts and edamame appear (December 2024; June 2026), but edamame came with butter; no vegan information.
kyoto_cloud10_pub.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00; Sat–Sun 15:00–1:00; open all year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service or table charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料 チャージ無」). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB), QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 33 seats: counter 9, tables 9, and a second-floor party room for 24 with karaoke and a projector (Tabelog). Heated tobacco only in a designated area (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink ¥2,500; with 5 dishes ¥3,500; with 7 dishes ¥4,500 (official site). Yanaginobamba south of Rokkaku, 5 min from Hankyu Karasuma or Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 1 March 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cloud10_pub.notes: [British-style pub · Yanaginobamba, open to 1 am] A two-floor pub off Rokkaku with Guinness on tap, whiskies such as Ichiro's Malt, and pub food — fish and chips with house tartar, pizza, meatball bolognese, ajillo — until 1:00, from 15:00 at weekends. No cover charge; drinks around ¥750. The upstairs room with karaoke takes parties of 24.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a British-style pub opened in March 2021 with world beers and whiskies; reviewers describe it as an Irish pub.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 regular finally tried the meatball bolognese on a last night in Kyoto after long being curious, and wished it had been sooner.
A June 2026 business traveller arrived for a third round around midnight and was welcomed warmly.
A June 2024 party extended the all-you-can-drink by an hour and was held strictly to the three-hour limit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: バー・パブ、中京区柳馬場通六角下る井筒屋町418-1、阪急烏丸駅・河原町駅から徒歩5分、月〜金17:00〜翌1:00、土日15:00〜翌1:00、年中無休、予約可、サービス料・チャージなし、カード・QUICPay・QR 可、33席 (カウンター9、テーブル9、2階貸切24名、カラオケとプロジェクター)、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙可、2021年3月1日オープン、本格的なブリティッシュパブ、世界のビールとウイスキー、自家製タルタルのフィッシュアンドチップス、鶏と玉ねぎのアヒージョ、飲み放題2,500円・料理5品付き3,500円・7品付き4,500円。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年8月、英語): Guinness、Ichiro’s Malt と Laphroaig のハイボール、ミートボールのボロネーゼ、ピザ、ドリンク750円、枝豆のバター焼き、フライドポテト。

cultural_comfort.note: A pub crowd that includes many overseas visitors (2024–25 reviews). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_matamoya_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: shumai and fried tofu in the course, with soy-based dishes throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_matamoya_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, beef tendon, grilled ham, mentaiko, stingray fin (2026 reviews).
kyoto_matamoya_sanjo.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 18:00–0:00 (last order 23:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–0:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a free sashimi platter in your birthday month when booked through Tabelog (Tabelog; September 2026). Appetizer charge ¥500 per person (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「旬の旨いお通し 1人様500円 頂戴しており〼」). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 26 seats: a 6-seat counter and tables for 4 and 6 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, with five ventilation fans (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Pontocho Matsushimaya Building 2F, Ishiyacho east of Kawaramachi-Sanjo, 2 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog). Opened 15 April 2026; reopened after renewal on 18 April (Tabelog).
kyoto_matamoya_sanjo.notes: [Sake bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, since 2026] A second-floor sake bar near Keihan Sanjo, opened in April 2026, pouring sakes rarely seen in Kansai with seasonal snacks — yuzu-scented fried tofu, stingray fin you grill yourself, sashimi, beef tendon — and a ¥6,000 course with all-you-can-drink. Good for solo drinking. Closed Monday; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sake bar that opened in April 2026 with over 10 sakes from across Japan, for a first stop, one more drink or a last glass.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor found sakes not often seen in Kansai and staff fun to talk to on a solo night.
A June 2026 girls’ night booked the ¥6,000 course and found the room a little too dim to read the menu.
A September 2026 visitor showed a driving licence during a birthday month and got a seven-piece sashimi platter free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本酒バー・居酒屋、中京区河原町三条下ル東入ル石屋町121 先斗町松嶋屋ビル 2F、京阪三条駅から徒歩2分、火〜金18:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、土日祝17:00〜24:00、月曜休み、予約可、お通し500円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、26席、喫煙可 (換気扇5台)、車椅子可、2026年4月15日オープン (4月18日にリニューアルオープン)、全国の日本酒10種以上。口コミ (2026年4月〜9月、英語): 関西では珍しい日本酒、柚子の香りの油揚げ、自分で炙るエイヒレ、飲み放題付きコース6,000円 (玉子豆腐、刺身、牛すじ大根、焼売、ハム焼き、yam の明太焼き、鶏ときのこのご飯、さつまいものアイス)、誕生月は刺身の盛り合わせが無料。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter suits solo drinkers; ask staff to pick a sake. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_coupe_de_champagne_gion.gf_detail: Ask. A champagne bar; snacks include fresh strawberries, prosciutto and French fries (2024–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_coupe_de_champagne_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. A champagne bar; seasonal fruit such as strawberries is served with the wine (2024–26 reviews), but no vegan information.
kyoto_coupe_de_champagne_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 19:00–0:00; closed Sunday; may change (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Counter seating (Tabelog). No smoking (July 2026). Hanami Kaikan 4F, on the west side of Hanamikoji north of Shijo, 5 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; February 2024). Opened 29 March 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_coupe_de_champagne_gion.notes: [Champagne bar · Hanamikoji, since 2013] A quiet fourth-floor counter bar off Hanamikoji that pours only champagne — grower bottles, prestige cuvées and rare Salon vintages, with several good ones always open by the glass — alongside seasonal strawberries, freshly sliced prosciutto and fries. Reviewers spend ¥3,000 for a glass or two to ¥15,000 for bottles. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), praised for warm hospitality (March and July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar specialising in champagne, opened in March 2013 in Gion.
chef_bio.specialty: Champagne by the glass and bottle.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor called it the best champagne bar in Japan for prestige cuvées poured by the glass.
A February 2024 visitor was welcomed with Kotoka strawberries and Egly-Ouriet by the glass.
A March 2024 diner admired the bar’s slicer and the bubbly-light prosciutto it produced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、東山区祇園四条花見小路上ル西側 花見会館 4F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土19:00〜24:00、日曜休み、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、カウンター席、2013年3月29日オープン、シャンパーニュ専門のバー。口コミ (2017年4月〜2026年7月、英語): シャンパーニュだけでほかのワインはない、グラスで飲める上質なシャンパーニュ、Salon などの古いヴィンテージ、マグナム、生産者のブラン・ド・ノワール、Kotoka のいちご、Egly-Ouriet、生ハム、フライドポテト、京都のいちご、禁煙、温かいもてなし。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask what is open by the glass; staff are happy to talk champagne (February 2024). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_gion_uwota_roast_beef.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: French courses with sauces, grilled rice balls in tea and pastry desserts (2016–2026 reviews); the shop asks to be told of allergies in advance (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_uwota_roast_beef.vegan_detail: Not vegan: roast Kuroge Wagyu, foie gras and eel courses (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_uwota_roast_beef.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday and the third Tuesday, plus irregular days. Reservations taken; tell the shop of allergies in advance. Service charge 10% at dinner only, no cover — Tabelog, Japanese original 「ディナータイムのみサービス料10％、チャージ料なし」. 40 seats with private rooms for 2–20 over two floors. Non-smoking (ashtray at the entrance at dinner). Cards; no e-money or QR. A February 2023 reviewer warns the phone is often unanswered after 20:00. A renovated townhouse in Gion-machi Minamigawa, a short walk from Hanamikoji.
kyoto_gion_uwota_roast_beef.notes: [Kyoto French & roast beef · Gion Minamigawa, a townhouse dining room] A renovated Gion machiya serving Kyoto-tinged French courses that peak with tender Kuroge Wagyu roast beef — foie gras with truffle, chazuke rice balls to finish — about ¥15,000 at dinner, cheaper at lunch, with private rooms upstairs. 10% service at dinner. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2016 describe a friendly owner and staff in a Gion townhouse turned French restaurant, renovated again before December 2025, with roast beef as the signature and good value for Gion. Criticism: a reservation mix-up and an unanswered phone after 8 pm (February 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Kuroge Wagyu roast beef; Kyoto French courses.

anecdotes.text: April 2024: "The foie gras was the best I've ever had in my life… The little grilled rice balls served with tea over them as a finale were cute and delightful."
March 2026: "Each dish was visually stunning… The staff were all very kind, skillfully gauging the right timing for service."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ローストビーフとフレンチのお店 祇園 うを多、フレンチ・ヨーロッパ料理・日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-170、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、月・火・木〜日・祝 11:30〜15:00・18:00〜22:00、水曜と第3火曜休み、不定休あり、予約可 (アレルギーは事前に)、原文で「ディナータイムのみサービス料10％、チャージ料なし」、40席、個室 (2〜20名)、禁煙 (夜は入口に灰皿)、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、法人会員。口コミ (2016年11月〜2026年3月、英語): 町家を改装したフレンチ、黒毛和牛のローストビーフ、ディナーコースC (6品) 15,000円 (うなぎの前菜、フォアグラとトリュフ)、締めの焼きおにぎりの茶漬け、デザート、昼のコース、ウェッジウッドの器、気さくな店主、夜8時以降は電話がつながりにくい (2023年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms; 10% service at dinner.

existence.note: Tabelog corporate-member listing with reviews dated December 2025 and March 2026.

kyoto_the_cellar_kyoto.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: French-style courses with sauces and a seasoned-rice finish (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_cellar_kyoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood carpaccio, salmon and beef steak in the courses (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_cellar_kyoto.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:30–22:30 (last entry 20:30; food last order 20:30, drinks 22:00); irregular closures. Reservation only — ring the intercom on the 2nd floor; a hidden door behind a bookshelf leads to the rooms (2024; 2026). No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」; no private-room fee with a course. 24 seats in fully private rooms (couple booths, sofa booths, tables) for up to 6; larger groups by phone. Cards, e-money and QR. 2nd floor of エアポートビル, just north-east of Kawaramachi-Sanjo. A bar area as well (October 2024).
kyoto_the_cellar_kyoto.notes: [Hidden private-room dining · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, a bookshelf door] Ring the intercom, push a bookshelf aside and you are in a wine-cellar warren of private booths: French-style courses with Japanese ingredients (about ¥7,000 for six dishes in 2024) and wine pairings. Popular for dates and birthdays. Reservation only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 describe a hidden restaurant entered by intercom and a secret passage, with fully private rooms styled like a wine cellar, French presentation of Japanese ingredients and well-timed service — "It felt almost like there was a camera watching me!" (September 2022). Tabelog lists it as a corporate member; no operator is named.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "Once inside, I was amazed to see bookshelves lined up, and when one of them moved aside, it revealed a passageway."
September 2024: "We enjoyed 6 dishes for JPY 7,000, tax and service included."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: The Cellar KYOTO、レストラン・ワインバー、中京区河原町三条上ル1筋目東入ル恵比須町534-9 エアポートビル 2F、地下鉄京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:30〜22:30 (最終入店20:30、料理 L.O. 20:30、ドリンク L.O. 22:00)、不定休、予約制、原文でサービス料「なし」、24席 (完全個室、カップル・ソファ・テーブル)、コースなら個室料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、法人会員。口コミ (2022年8月〜2026年9月、英語): インターホンで入り本棚の隠し扉から個室へ、ワインセラーのような個室、和の食材をフレンチの見せ方で、6品7,000円 (税・サービス込み、2024年9月)、桃のサラダ、鯛とたこのカルパッチョ、サーモンのソテー、牛ステーキ、炊き込みご飯、フルーツのデザート、ワインのペアリング、自家製ソース、刺身、海鮮ご飯、誕生日のプレートと写真、バーの利用も。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; intercom entry; private rooms.

existence.note: Tabelog corporate-member listing with reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_yanagiya_honten_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy for sushi and sashimi, fugu and hamo tempura, ponzu hotpots (2014–2025 reviews).
kyoto_yanagiya_honten_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, fugu, hamo and eel (2014–2025 reviews).
kyoto_yanagiya_honten_sanjo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:30–13:30 and 16:30–21:30; closed Wednesday; hours may change. Reservations taken — needed for fugu and hamo courses (2019; December 2025). Counter in a long narrow "eel-bed" room and tatami seating; take-away bento. Cards. English menu (June 2020). On the corner of Sanjo-dori and Tominokoji. Founded 1926, third generation (November 2015 review).
kyoto_yanagiya_honten_sanjo.notes: [Sushi & Kyoto seafood · Sanjo-dori at Tominokoji, since 1926] A third-generation sushi house in a long Kyoto "eel-bed" room on Sanjo-dori, with cheap lunch sets and, by reservation, wild-fugu feasts in winter and hamo courses in summer. Reviews of the everyday sushi are mixed. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A November 2015 reviewer gives the founding as 1926, with the third generation in charge; in May 2016 "the restaurant is run by a young couple". In December 2025 "the chef personally provided attentive service at our table, handling the grilling and hot pot" for a wild-fugu course, and company year-end parties are held here. Criticism: a poor sushi lunch with sweet rice and slow service (May 2014), and no background music (December 2025).

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "This restaurant that serves natural fugu truly stands out. I savored each dish, from grilled soft roe to soft roe tempura, and enjoyed the Hirezake until the very end."
July 2022: "In Kyoto, it's said that people have a tradition of eating conger eel during the Gion Matsuri festival… We thoroughly enjoyed a leisurely conger eel full-course meal."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 柳家本店、日本料理・魚介料理・寿司、中京区三条通富小路角中之町23、京都市役所前から432m、月・火・木〜日 11:30〜13:30・16:30〜21:30、水曜休み、時間は変わることがある、カード可、カウンター・座敷、テイクアウト。口コミ (2014年5月〜2025年12月、英語): 1926年創業、三代目 (2015年11月)、若い夫婦が営む (2016年5月)、うなぎの寝床の店、天然ふぐのコース (焼き白子、白子の天ぷら、ひれ酒、2025年12月)、祇園祭のころの鱧のコース、鱧の点心ランチ、鱧の子の酢漬け、鱧の骨の唐揚げ、うなぎのコースとさば寿司 (2019年7月)、昼は約1,500円の寿司・鉄火丼・海鮮丼・刺身、持ち帰りの鱧カツ重弁当1,000円 (2020年6月)、だし巻き、寿司の昼は物足りない (2014年5月)、BGMがない (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; book ahead for fugu and hamo courses.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated July 2025, December 2025 and July 2026.

kyoto_sumibi_toriyaki_haku.gf_detail: Ask: salted chicken grilled yourself may suit, but karaage, fried cartilage, nyumen and tare do not (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_toriyaki_haku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a grill-your-own chicken izakaya (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_toriyaki_haku.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–24:00; closing days not fixed. A January 2026 reviewer says it closes at 3 am — check. Reservations taken (seat type by phone; groups of 4+ by phone); 2-hour limit when busy. 22 seats: tables and a tatami area with children's toys (October 2026); private room for 10–15; whole-shop hire 20–25. Non-smoking. Cards; no e-money or QR. Up steep stairs to the 2nd floor, Ebisu-cho north of Kawaramachi-Sanjo.
kyoto_sumibi_toriyaki_haku.notes: [Grill-your-own chicken · north of Kawaramachi-Sanjo, shichirin yakitori] A cosy second-floor chicken izakaya where you grill the cuts yourself over charcoal — platters of five or ten — with fresh liver sashimi, karaage and TKG to finish; a tatami corner with toys suits families. Some found it pricey or short of stock. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists it as a corporate member. Reviewers in 2025–2026 praise very fresh branded chicken and pleasant staff; criticism: items out of stock (March 2026), a lukewarm, over-peppered nyumen (May 2026), chicken sashimi with "no texture at all" and value that "isn't that great" — just over ¥10,000 for a 10-skewer platter, four highballs and two dishes (May 2026), and slow drinks for a group of seven (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "You can grill the chicken yourself on a charcoal grill, just like yakiniku! The freshness is outstanding, and the liver sashimi is especially amazing."
October 2026: "The restaurant also has a tatami area with children's toys, making it a family-friendly spot."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭火鶏焼 白久、居酒屋・鶏料理、中京区河原町三条上る恵比須町534-13 2F、地下鉄京都市役所前駅から徒歩約2分、毎日 18:00〜24:00、不定休、予約可 (席の指定や4名以上は電話)、混雑時は2時間制、22席 (テーブル10、座敷12)、個室 (10〜15名)、貸切20〜25名、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、法人会員。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 七輪で自分で焼く鶏、5種・10種の盛り合わせ (もも、むね、皮、なんこつ、親鶏)、わさび塩と卵黄のたれ、鶏刺し、レバ刺し、鶏ユッケ、もも唐揚げ、なんこつの唐揚げ、半熟卵のポテサラ、湯葉ポン酢、しそつくね、締めの卵かけご飯と鶏だしのにゅうめん、子供のおもちゃのある座敷、朝3時までとの声 (2026年1月)、品切れが多い (2026年3月)、にゅうめんがぬるい (2026年5月)、コスパはいまひとつとの声 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Grill-it-yourself; steep stairs; family tatami corner.

existence.note: Tabelog corporate-member listing with reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_classlobe.gf_detail: Not GF: parfaits are layered with cookies, cake and crumble (2026 reviews).
kyoto_classlobe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: parfaits of cream, milk ice cream and chocolate (2026 reviews).
kyoto_classlobe.hours_raw: Monday and Thursday–Sunday 13:00–17:45; Tuesday 13:00–17:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome; sofa seats and an open terrace (Tabelog). Two floors of a renovated machiya with a small garden; take-away drinks (2026 reviews). Takakura-Bukkoji, about 300 m from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 29 April 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_classlobe.notes: [Parfait café · Takakura-Bukkoji machiya] A calm two-storey townhouse café with a small garden, building tall seasonal parfaits — strawberry, Hokkaido haskap, orange and kumquat — layer by layer with jelly, crumble and milk ice cream, or a smaller mini parfait with tea. Afternoons only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: CLASS LOBE by world tea labo, a café in Shimogyo-ku. Per Tabelog: opened 29 April 2022 in a renovated townhouse.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 solo diner in middle age had the haskap parfait with iced coffee in the townhouse with its small garden, admiring the layers from tart fruit down to strawberry jelly.
An August 2026 pair, already full, shared mini parfaits while a staff member explained each texture and ice cream.
A September 2026 guest found the haskap parfait sold out and the one ordered photogenic but ordinary in taste.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: CLASS LOBE (クラスローブ) by world tea labo、京都市下京区のカフェ。食べログ: カフェ・ジェラート・アイスクリーム、下京区西前町367-4、四条駅から303m、月・木〜日 13:00〜17:45、火 13:00〜17:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、子ども可、ソファ席・テラス、2022年4月29日開店。口コミ (2026年6月〜9月、英語): 町家を改装した2階建てのカフェと小さな庭、季節のパフェ (いちご2,400円、北海道のハスカップと自家製クランブル、オレンジと金柑、チョコのミニパフェ1,500円、国産いちごと自家製チョコのミニパフェ1,600円)、パフェとセットの飲み物300円、ミルクティー、カフェオレ、夏のベリーとマンゴーのソーダ、ハスカップが売り切れで味は普通だったとの声 (2026年9月)、テイクアウトもできる。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead at weekends; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_hisami_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: udon and soba, tempura, fried shrimp and katsudon (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hisami_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broths, herring, fish, beef and offal (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hisami_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–2:00 (last order 1:30); closed Sunday, plus irregular days; hours may change (Tabelog). Busiest around 19:00; easier after 21:00 (March 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; April 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, 6 at tables (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Seven Building 1F, a little north of Shijo off Hanamikoji (Tabelog; December 2025).
kyoto_hisami_gion.notes: [Udon izakaya · Gion, till 2 a.m.] A small, friendly Gion counter where the night crowd ends up: a long list of small plates — sashimi, fried shrimp, mentaiko shirataki, grilled skirt — then nabeyaki udon or herring soba to finish. Packed early in the evening; easier after 9 p.m. Closed Sunday; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a 13-seat izakaya on the Hanamikoji side of Gion open until 2:00, known for its udon and a wide menu from obanzai to finishing noodles and rice bowls, with many regulars (2024–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular insists on the nabeyaki udon and the tarako shirataki on the side; the place is always packed.
An August 2026 party of four with guests from Tokyo shared sashimi, grilled skirt, fried shrimp and oysters, then chicken nanban udon.
A September 2025 visitor was sent here after drinks by a bar hostess and found everything tasty, especially the udon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん・居酒屋、東山区清本町378 セブンビル 1F、祇園四条から372m、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00 (L.O.1:30)、日曜休み、不定休、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、13席 (カウンター7、テーブル6)、喫煙可、日本酒・焼酎。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 花見小路の四条の少し北、おばんざい、刺身、明太子の糸こん、いかの甘辛、たこや、とうもろこしの天ぷら、海老フライ、ハラミ、揚げたホルモン、生牡蠣、アヒージョ風の「Yamamoto Steak」、締めの鍋焼きうどん、鶏南蛮うどん、特製にしんそば、にしん丼、肉そば、かつ丼、店主と料理人のもてなし (2026年4月)、19時は混み21時ごろから空く (2026年3月)、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small late-night counter; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_caffe_terrace_isola_daimaru.gf_detail: Not GF: the gozen sets are mostly cakes, cookies, crêpes, roll cake and mille-feuille (2026 reviews).
kyoto_caffe_terrace_isola_daimaru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: panna cotta, cheesecake, ice cream and cream sweets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_caffe_terrace_isola_daimaru.hours_raw: Daily 13:00–17:30; closed when Daimaru Kyoto is closed (Tabelog). No reservations; a queue forms before 13:00 (Tabelog; June 2026). The seasonal gozen is limited and can sell out, with a restock around 15:00 (April 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 26 seats indoors plus the rooftop terrace; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Spend ¥2,000 or more and borrow a picnic set for the roof garden free (March 2026). Drinks come in paper cups even to eat in (March 2026). 8F of Daimaru Kyoto, by the roof garden; reached underground from Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo Stns (Tabelog). Opened 19 March 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_caffe_terrace_isola_daimaru.notes: [Sweets café · Daimaru Kyoto 8F, roof terrace] A bright café beside Daimaru's roof garden from the team behind TEA LOUNGE ISOLA: seasonal "colour gozen" boxes of ten tiny sweets — strawberry, peach, matcha — with tea or espresso, plus parfaits and summer kakigori, indoors or out on the terrace. Opens 13:00; queue early, the gozen sells out.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: the sister café of the popular TEA LOUNGE ISOLA at Shijo-Karasuma, opened on the 8th floor of Daimaru Kyoto in March 2026 (Tabelog: 19 March 2026), next to the rooftop garden.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor found the strawberry gozen sold out just before 14:00; the staff kept one from the 15:00 restock for the guest to come back for.
A March 2026 guest borrowed the free picnic set, offered on spends over ¥2,000, to eat a strawberry parfait out on the roof terrace.
A March 2026 diner liked the prices but not the paper cups for eat-in, nor the ageing roof building around the terrace.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、下京区四条通高倉西入立売西町79 大丸京都店 8F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から地下でつながる、毎日 13:00〜17:30、大丸京都店の休みに準ずる、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、26席、テラス、車椅子可、子ども可、2026年3月19日開店。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 四条烏丸の TEA LOUNGE ISOLA の姉妹店、屋上庭園の隣、季節の「Colour Gozen」(小さな菓子約10種と飲み物): いちご2,000円 (3月)、抹茶 (6月)、桃 (7月)、無花果とシャインマスカット、抹茶と煎茶2,500円 (10月)、丹後のいちごのパフェ、夏のかき氷、エスプレッソとお茶、2,000円以上でピクニックセットを無料で貸し出し (2026年3月)、御膳は数量限定で15時に追加 (2026年4月)、13時前から行列 (2026年6月)、店内でも紙コップ (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; queue before 13:00; wheelchair accessible; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened March 2026; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_toutou_to_yumiyacho.gf_detail: Not GF: toast, egg sandwiches, French toast and set meals with fried dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toutou_to_yumiyacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg sandwiches, pudding, omurice and butter toast (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toutou_to_yumiyacho.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday–Sunday and holidays 8:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday, but open on Wednesdays of odd-numbered weeks; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; June 2025). Counter and table seats (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Hot water and a damp towel on arrival (November 2024). Yamatooji south of Matsubara near Miyagawa-cho, down narrow lanes; about 400 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews). Opened 12 October 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_toutou_to_yumiyacho.notes: [Kissa · Yamatooji-Matsubara, from 8 a.m., cash only] A Showa kissa that kept the tables, sofas and till of the beloved Kissa Suzuki, which closed after 53 years: morning toast and coffee from 8, a chunky egg sandwich, a monthly set lunch and a firm pudding with bitter caramel. Hot water and a towel when you sit. Closed Tuesday and most Wednesdays; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: opened (Tabelog: 12 October 2023) by a new owner who took over Kissa Suzuki, a local coffee shop of 53 years, keeping its tables, chairs, till and sofas (April 2024) and, per a June 2024 reviewer, its recipes and atmosphere.
chef_bio.philosophy: Carrying on the recipes and mood of the old Kissa Suzuki (June 2024).

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 visitor overheard locals discussing a small rise in breakfast prices, and was warmed by hot water rather than cold on a chilly morning.
An October 2026 guest copied another table and ordered the DIY popcorn, taking the leftovers home, with a firm adult pudding.
An April 2024 visitor loved the egg sandwich but found the service curt when asking for toast without butter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶店、東山区大和大路通り松原下る弓矢町35、清水五条から394m、月・木〜日・祝 8:00〜18:00、火・水休み (奇数週の水曜は営業)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター席、喫煙可、2023年10月12日開店。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 53年続いたKissa Suzukiを新しい店主が引き継ぎ、テーブル、椅子、レジ、ソファもそのまま、レシピと雰囲気も受け継ぐ (2024年6月)、朝8時からモーニング、たまごサンド、バタートースト、チーズトースト、月替わりの定食 (春巻きと唐揚げ990円)、プリンオムライス、固めの大人のプリン480円、DIY ポップコーン420円、バナナジュース、クリームソーダ、季節のフレンチトースト、最初にお湯とおしぼり (2024年11月)、現金のみ (2025年6月)、バターなしを断られ接客が冷たかったとの声 (2024年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; local regulars; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_cocotte_alpha_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak and vegetables may suit, but garlic rice, meat sushi, soups and sauces are unknown (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cocotte_alpha_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu steak courses with fish and shrimp (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cocotte_alpha_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; Retty describes it as reservation-only. No service charge or cover (Tabelog Japanese original 「サービス料・チャージなし」). Bring your own wine at ¥3,000 a bottle (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, two tables of four (Tabelog). 3rd floor of the 京都ゴールデンビル on Kiyamachi, with windows over the Takase River, 3 min from Sanjo (Tabelog; Retty; January and September 2025 reviews).
kyoto_cocotte_alpha_kiyamachi.notes: [Wagyu teppanyaki · Kiyamachi] A small third-floor teppanyaki counter on Kiyamachi where a veteran chef grills A4–A5 black wagyu and Kyoto vegetables in front of you, with views over the Takase River. Courses about ¥10,000–17,000; no service charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 24 December 2019 (Tabelog). A veteran chef with over 40 years' experience (Tabelog). Listed on Retty as the "河原町本店".

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 anniversary couple took the ¥16,500 Kyoto Premium course, whose salad of eel and corn was the surprise.
A September 2025 diner expected the thick hanger steak to be tough and found it melting.
An August 2026 couple felt the prices did not match the quality: two slices of hamachi, one steak not cooked as ordered, plain warabi mochi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 演出鉄板ステーキ&BAR ココットアルファ、鉄板焼き・ステーキ・イタリアン、中京区材木町175 京都ゴールデンビル3F、三条駅6番出口から徒歩約3分、毎日 12:00〜14:00・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、サービス料・チャージなし、ワイン持ち込み1本3,000円、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、15席 (カウンター7、4人テーブル2)、2019年12月24日オープン、A4以上の黒毛和牛と京野菜、料理歴40年以上の料理人 (紹介文、英訳)。Retty: 鉄板ステーキ ココットアルファ 河原町本店、完全予約制、高瀬川の夜景。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): Kyoto Premium course 16,500円、サーロイン80g とヒレ60g、うなぎととうもろこしのサラダ、ガーリックライス、肉寿司、ハラミ、サーモンの刺身、鱧、ハマチのカルパッチョ、わらび餅。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter teppanyaki; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and Retty; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_kishizushi_miyagawa.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi rice and fish, but soy sauce, simmered-eel glaze and red miso soup are likely wheat or soy-based (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kishizushi_miyagawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish sushi and sashimi (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kishizushi_miyagawa.hours_raw: Mon 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:00; Thu, Fri and the days around holidays 17:00–21:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; closed Tue and Wed (Tabelog). Weekday lunch by booking; dinner bookings until 18:00, then first come, until sold out; takeaway outside hours on request; bookings by agents not accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: 5 at the counter, 6 at tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). On Miyagawa-suji near Matsubara, 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo or Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; June 2026 review).
kyoto_kishizushi_miyagawa.notes: [Kyoto sushi · Miyagawacho] A small, long-established Kyoto sushi shop, founded in 1914 and moved in 2023 to a modern room on Miyagawa-suji: pressed and kizushi mackerel, isomaki and nigiri at modest prices, with a few appetizers and sake. Lunch about ¥3,000; dinner ¥5,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1914 (September 2024 and October 2023 reviews). Moved in 2023 from an old house on the Kawaramachi side to a modern ground floor across the Kamo River, keeping the same sign; a chef and a server (October 2023 review). A June 2026 diner had used its takeaway at an earlier Teramachi location. A small team that takes its time (Tabelog). A July 2025 reviewer had heard it is known to serve geiko and okiya.
chef_bio.philosophy: Unhurried, careful work by a small team (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A regular of thirteen visits found the tuna and squid legs sold out in September 2026, missed the old regulars, and noted prices rose a little around autumn 2025.
A June 2026 couple walked over the Kamo River and ordered isomaki, pickled small sea bream, kizushi and tekka maki, and liked the value.
An October 2023 diner found the stylish new room changed but the pressed sushi as good as at the old house.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: きし鮓、寿司、東山区宮川筋5-333-1 1F、清水五条駅から350m、月曜 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜21:00、木・金・祝前後日 17:00〜21:00、土日祝 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜20:30、火・水休み、平日昼は予約制、夜の予約は18:00まで (以降は先着、売り切れまで)、代理予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、11席 (カウンター5、テーブル6)、禁煙、車いす可、少人数で丁寧に。口コミ (2026年6月、日本語): 磯巻、小鯛漬け、酢の物三点盛り、煮穴子の炙り、しまあじのたたき、きずしをわさびと大根おろしで、鉄火巻、コストパフォーマンスがとても良い。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 1914年創業、2023年に河原町側から鴨川の東へ移転、押し寿司、おまかせ8貫2,700円、磯巻4切れ700円、赤だし550円、上ちらし、2025年秋に値上げ、Densho や Konteki の日本酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; many overseas guests lately (2025 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_gion_manyoken_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Classical French courses with sauces, bread and petits fours (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manyoken_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: classical French meat and fish courses (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manyoken_honten.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00, last entry 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:30, last entry 20:00); closed Tue and Wed; summer break 16–20 August (Tabelog). Bookings through the website; reservation-only in practice (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Service charge 10% (Tabelog Japanese original 「サービス料10％」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats; private rooms; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Hanamikoji in a renovated tea house, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_manyoken_honten.notes: [French · Hanamikoji] Kyoto's century-old French house, founded in 1904 and now in a renovated tea house on Hanamikoji: orthodox French courses in a quiet, reservation-only room. Lunch about ¥8,000–10,000; dinner ¥15,000–20,000 plus 10% service.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1904; has served VIPs since an imperial banquet at the Imperial Palace in 1928 (Tabelog). At this renovated Hanamikoji tea house since 18 April 2013 (Tabelog); earlier on another site (September 2019 review). The group also runs MANYOKEN style in Takashimaya Kyoto (kyoto_manyoken_style_takashimaya).
chef_bio.philosophy: Orthodox French cooking with pride in its history (December 2022 review).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner sent by a local friend arrived at 7:30 pm, took the ¥15,000 course and found it surprisingly good value with wine at ¥1,300 a glass.
In December 2023 a diner who had booked three months ahead found Hanamikoji quiet, the dishes carefully explained, and was urged to order more baguette for the escargot butter.
A diner who had passed it since student days finally went in September 2019, after its move.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎをん 萬養軒 本店、フレンチ・ステーキ・洋食、東山区祇園町南側570-120 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月・木〜日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、火・水休み、8月16〜20日は夏休み、予約は公式サイトから、サービス料10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、個室、禁煙、2013年4月18日 (現在地) オープン、1904年創業、花見小路のお茶屋を改装、1928年の宮中晩餐会以来 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 正統派のフレンチ、夜のコース19,000円 (税・サ込み、2022年12月)、15,000円のコースとグラスワイン1,300円 (2026年10月)、昼のコースと茶菓子、移転。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead through the website.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (summer-break notice) and own site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_dining_harimaya_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto courses with miso, soy and wheat-based dishes such as fu and kuzu sauces (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_dining_harimaya_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, duck, grilled fish, matsutake dobin-mushi in dashi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_dining_harimaya_sanjo.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–14:50 (food L.O. 13:00, drinks 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 19:30, drinks 21:30); closed Mondays (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: counter, tables, private rooms with sunken kotatsu (Tabelog; March 2026 review). 1 min from Keihan Sanjo, on Yamato-oji south of Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_dining_harimaya_sanjo.notes: [Kyoto courses & sake · Sanjo] A Sanjo Keihan dining room with a counter and sunken-kotatsu rooms, serving monthly Kyoto courses with an artful hassun and a deep list of rare sake. Lunch about ¥5,000; dinner from ¥8,000.

chef_bio.background: Run by the brother of the owner of Harikiyo, a ryotei of 350 years, according to a December 2025 regular of nearly ten years. A warm owner (December 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A regular of nearly ten years (December 2025) singled out the monthly hassun and the rare sake chosen to match each dish.
A December 2025 diner used a hometown-tax voucher for the ¥8,000 dinner course, decorated for Christmas.
A September 2026 guest called the matsutake dobin-mushi the champion of matsutake dishes and switched to Kanehachi sake midway.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: dining HARIMAYA、ダイニングバー・日本料理、東山区大和大路通三条下ル新伍軒町181 Cabin三条AQUA 1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩1分、火〜日 11:30〜14:50 (料理 L.O. 13:00)・17:30〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 19:30)、月曜休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、30席 (カウンター、テーブル、個室、掘りごたつ)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 毎月替わる献立、夜のコース8,000円から (海老芋の柚子味噌、鴨とじゃがいもの饅頭、お造り、八寸、鰆の味噌焼き、鰤の蒸し物、湯葉の炊き込みご飯、赤だし、黒蜜のフォンデュ)、昼5,300円 (bubu mochi、葛餅)、松茸の土瓶蒸し、珍しい日本酒、Harikiyo の店主の弟の店 (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and private rooms; sake recommendations.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_osake_no_jinja_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai in dashi, sashimi, grilled gyoza, Wagyu sukiyaki and beef-tongue shabu-shabu in a soy-based broth; no gluten information (own site; Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_osake_no_jinja_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the obanzai and hot pots are built on dashi, with meat and fish throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_osake_no_jinja_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday and holidays 12:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 42 seats: 37 at tables and 5 at the counter; groups up to 40 (Tabelog). Heated tobacco only, with a smoking area for cigarettes (Tabelog). Through a narrow entrance on Sanjo-dori, ground floor of 御所飴ビル, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; March and April 2026). Opened 1 February 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_osake_no_jinja_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo by the bridge, a shrine-themed sake bar] Down a narrow entrance on Sanjo-dori, a 42-seat izakaya made up like a shrine at night, with gagaku playing: pick obanzai from the counter, then sashimi platters, sea bream, Wagyu sukiyaki or beef-tongue shabu-shabu, with sake from across Japan. Open from noon; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site and Tabelog describe an izakaya inspired by a shrine at night, popular with guests from Japan and abroad, serving Kyoto sake and dishes meant to convey Japanese food culture. A March 2026 diner was told the fish comes through acquaintances of the shop. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner, expecting a tourist trap from the gagaku and festive look, found the five-kind sashimi platter arriving like a ryokan boat platter.
A March 2026 diner asked for risotto to finish the shrimp hot pot and went back for seconds.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都 お酒の神社、神社のような落ち着いた空間で日本酒と和食、海外からも人気の居酒屋、和牛すき焼き、牛タンしゃぶしゃぶ、京都産日本酒。食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区中島町98 御所飴ビル 1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木〜日・祝 12:00〜22:00、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR可、42席 (テーブル37、カウンター5)、加熱式たばこのみ、2026年2月1日オープン、本日のおばんざい盛り合わせ2,200円、刺身三種盛り2,500円・五種盛り4,500円、焼き餃子、Shrine Fried Tofu。口コミ (2026年3・4月、英語): 三条通の狭い入口、雅楽、カウンターのおばんざいから5種 (鴨ロース、魚の南蛮漬け、焼き茄子、肉じゃが、いかと筍の甘酢)、舟盛りのような刺身、鯛のあら炊き、焼き海老、海老鍋の締めのチーズリゾット、長芋入りチャンジャ、鯵の骨せんべい。

cultural_comfort.note: Popular with overseas guests (own site); open from noon.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated March and April 2026.

kyoto_maximo_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Tacos on corn tortillas, nachos and guacamole chips; whether the tortillas or fryer are shared with wheat is not stated (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_maximo_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Guacamole and chips are made in house, but no vegan dishes are named; tacos are mostly beef tongue, pork carnitas and shrimp (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_maximo_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Monday, Saturday and Sunday 15:00–23:00; Tuesday–Friday 17:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations recommended at busy times (May 2025). Cards: AMEX only; no QR (Tabelog). About 6–8 counter seats and a table downstairs, with more upstairs (March 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi north of Sanjo (恵比須町446), 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog).
kyoto_maximo_kiyamachi.notes: [Tex-Mex · Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, tacos and tequila] A small, colourful taco bar with a counter and an upstairs room, serving generous Tex-Mex tacos on corn tortillas — beef tongue, carnitas, shrimp and avocado — loaded nachos, house guacamole and tequila. Opens mid-afternoon at weekends; book at busy times. AMEX only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a small, efficient kitchen behind the counter (March 2026) and a room decorated with baseball memorabilia (April 2025). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor found the counter full on a Saturday at 5 pm, squeezed onto the one table, and saw later guests sent upstairs.
An April 2026 regular calls the nachos among the best in Japan.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: マキシモ、メキシコ料理・ダイニングバー、中京区恵比須町446、京都市役所前から徒歩4分、月・土・日 15:00〜23:00、火〜金 17:00〜23:00、カードはAMEXのみ、QR不可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): テックスメックスのタコス、牛タンのタコス、海老とアボカドのタコス、ナチョス、自家製ワカモレとチップス、豚のカルニタスのタコス、とうもろこしのトルティーヤ、パクチーは別注文、テキーラとカクテル、カウンター6〜8席とテーブル1卓、2階もあり、野球グッズの飾り。

cultural_comfort.note: Small bar; AMEX only; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_gion_yakiniku_keisho.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with house-made sauces and salt, braised Wagyu tendon, namul and kimchi; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_yakiniku_keisho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant — beef, offal and pork (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_gion_yakiniku_keisho.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–03:00; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Booking recommended — seating is limited (January 2025); late-night guests arrive after 11 pm (March 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 table seats (Tabelog). Heated tobacco only (Tabelog). In a Gion back lane, 岡崎ビル 1F, 5 min from the Gion bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_yakiniku_keisho.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion back lane, open till 3 am] A 24-seat Korean-style yakiniku in a Gion back lane, open till 3 am: premium salted tongue, skirt and kalbi with house sauces, a wide offal list, several kimchi to start, and a ¥6,500 course. Book ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text stresses fresh meat and careful cuts at reasonable prices with house-made sauces. Reviewers praise attentive staff (January 2025) and a friendly young server (May 2026). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner whose planned yakiniku spot was closed came on a whim, and rated the starters, yukhoe and liver above the tongue and skirt.
A March 2026 diner booked online after work, found it empty at 10 pm and filling up after 11.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園焼肉 慶尚、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、東山区祇園町北側279-6 岡崎ビル 1F、市バス祇園から徒歩5分、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00、日・祝定休、カード可、テーブル24席、加熱式たばこのみ、2024年8月1日オープン、自家製のたれの韓国焼肉、上塩タン1,815円、ネギ塩タン1,980円、上ハラミ1,870円、上カルビ1,870円、上ロース1,980円、ホルモン盛り合わせ1,815円、ハツ935円、レバー焼き990円、蒸し豚。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 梅コース6,500円 (和牛すじ煮込み、サラダ、豚塩カルビ、ナムル、キムチ、上ロース、上カルビ、ご飯)、数種類のキムチ、ユッケ、ミノ、深夜の客。

cultural_comfort.note: Small table-only room; open late.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_bakushu_yumeyomi.gf_detail: Not GF: a beer bar — Yebisu and craft beers are barley-based (reviews).
kyoto_bakushu_yumeyomi.vegan_detail: Ask. Snacks are few — mixed nuts, sweet-potato chips, Kyoto pickles, a sausage (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bakushu_yumeyomi.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Friday 16:30–24:00; Saturday 15:00–24:00; Sunday and holidays 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no cover charge (Tabelog). A small counter with standing room and a few chairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2022–2026 reviews). The lift opens straight into the bar, and the entrance is easy to miss (2022 reviews). Busy with beer lovers in the evening (2022 and September 2026). On the 2nd floor of the Shimaya Building on Shijo by Minami-za, steps from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2022 and 2024 reviews).
kyoto_bakushu_yumeyomi.notes: [Beer bar · Shijo by Minami-za, the Yebisu pour] A small second-floor beer bar by Minami-za — the lift opens straight into it — where a carefully poured Yebisu (about ¥850) draws beer lovers, with a few craft taps and simple snacks. Standing room and a counter; no cover charge; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in June 2021 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2022–2026) describe a small beer bar run by an earnest owner, recommended by other brewers and beer fans for its draught Yebisu; the kegs turn over fast — three in one day, a September 2025 guest was told.
chef_bio.specialty: Draught Yebisu poured with care; craft beer.

anecdotes.text: A July 2022 visitor came on the recommendation of the owner of Konoshima Beer in Higashiyama.
A September 2025 guest wanted a second Yebisu, but it had sold out — three kegs emptied that day.
A September 2026 drinker of big-brewery beer tried Yebisu poured in a single pour for the first time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麥酒 夢詠ミ、ビアバー、京都市東山区四条通大和大路西入ル中之町206 志満家ビル2F、月・水〜金 16:30〜24:00、土 15:00〜24:00、日祝 15:00〜22:00、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、チャージ料なし、禁煙、2021年6月26日オープン。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 南座のすぐ隣、エレベーターを降りるとすぐ店内、カウンターと立ち飲み、ヱビス800円 (2022年)・850円 (2024年)、京都一とも言われるヱビス、一度注ぎ、樽の回転が速い (1日に3樽)、クラフトビール (大山Gビールなど)、サッポロ、ピスタチオのサルシッチャ、ミックスナッツ、さつまいもチップス、京漬物、真面目な店主、ビール好きでにぎわう。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; no cover charge; standing room.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_maisushi_ayanokoji.gf_detail: Ask. Nigiri, sashimi and obanzai made with Fukushima Katsuo dashi; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_maisushi_ayanokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, fish dishes and dashi-based obanzai (official site).
kyoto_maisushi_ayanokoji.hours_raw: 16:00–21:30 (food last order 21:00), Friday–Tuesday; closed Wednesday, Thursday and every other Tuesday — check Instagram or Google Maps (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by Instagram DM or phone; courses can be booked ahead; weekend evenings fill early (official site; 2026 reviews). Cards and QR payments accepted (official site; Tabelog). A standing counter of 8–10 places; non-smoking (Tabelog; official site). Budget ¥6,000–8,000 (official site). On the ground floor of the Cosmo First building on Ayanokoji at Fuyacho, next to 焼肉力, about 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site; March 2026).
kyoto_maisushi_ayanokoji.notes: [Standing sushi · Ayanokoji, Maizuru fish and Aomori sake] A bright little standing sushi counter south of Shijo, opened in late 2025 by an owner from Hachinohe who trained at the Maizuru fish market. Nigiri from ¥600 — try the aged mackerel — with dashi obanzai and Aomori sake; courses about ¥6,000. Book at weekends; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner-sushi chef (from Hachinohe, Aomori), not named
chef_bio.background: The official site says the owner hand-makes each piece from Maizuru fish chosen by local brokers and stocks sake from the owner’s home town of Hachinohe. Reviewers (2026) describe a young woman from Aomori who trained for a year at a Maizuru fish market. The operator is 株式会社food&nature of Shimogyo, Kyoto (National Tax Agency invoice register T8040001115380).
chef_bio.philosophy: One piece, one glass: authentic sushi and sake enjoyed casually, standing, with conversation across the counter (official site).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 guest arrived before opening and watched the owner preparing; on weekends it can be full by 16:00.
A September 2026 local from northern Kyoto was delighted that most of the fish came from home waters.
A July 2026 business traveller booked a standing table for the Kyoto course and added water aubergine and oysters.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都 舞鮨、舞鶴港直送の魚で握るお寿司と京おばんざいの立ち飲み処、京都市下京区塩屋町80 コスモファースト1F、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩約5分、16:00〜21:30、水・木曜、隔週火曜定休、予約はInstagramのDMか電話、平均予算6,000〜8,000円、カード・QR可、10席。店主自ら一貫ずつ、超低温熟成の生鯖「舞鯖」、京鰆、都まぐろ、福島鰹の出汁の京おばんざい、店主の地元青森県八戸市の陸奥八仙など青森の地酒。メニュー: 魚の逸品600円〜 (なめろう、ごま鯖、へしこ、刺身盛り合わせ)、寿司各600円〜、アテ各400円〜 (八戸のイカの塩辛)、おばんざい500円〜、青森の地酒800〜1,000円。食べログ: 2025年12月20日オープン、8席、カウンターのみ、禁煙、インボイス T8040001115380 (株式会社food&nature)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 八戸出身の若い女性店主、舞鶴の市場で1年修業、剣コース6,000円、鶴コース6,500円、週末は16時で満席になることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing counter; book by Instagram DM or phone.

existence.note: Official site (opening days to late November 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kyokaiseki_shinya.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with sashimi, simmered dishes, tempura and miso dengaku; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kyokaiseki_shinya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of hamo, ayu, duck and Yanagawa loach pot (reviews).
kyoto_kyokaiseki_shinya.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 Monday–Saturday (holidays to 21:00); closed Sunday and holiday Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards accepted; no e-money or QR; no cover charge (Tabelog). 10 seats (12 when reserved whole); smoking allowed (Tabelog). The menu is in Japanese only (July 2025). On Kawabata-dori north of Shijo, ground floor of the No. 7 Kobashi Kaikan, near Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyokaiseki_shinya.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Kawabata by Shijo, a 50-year couple-run room] A ten-seat kaiseki room on Kawabata just north of Shijo, open since 1974 and run by a couple. Courses from about ¥6,000 — grilled fish, Yanagawa loach pot or tempura — or a summer course of hamo and young ayu. Japanese menu only; smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in April 1974 (Tabelog). A May 2022 reviewer found it run by a couple, with elegantly seasoned food; a July 2025 guest called it a hidden gem of 50 years.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 guest had dirty chopsticks swapped for fresh ones before each course, because it would change the taste.
A May 2022 diner recommends the homemade chirimen sansho served with the pickles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京懐石 新家、日本料理・海鮮・居酒屋、京都市東山区川端通四条上る常盤町177 第7小橋会館1F、月〜土 17:00〜22:00、祝日 17:00〜21:00、日曜・祝日の月曜定休、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、チャージなし、10席 (貸切12名)、喫煙可、1974年4月9日オープン、焼き魚のコース6,050円、柳川鍋のコース、天ぷらのコース。口コミ (2022〜2025年、英語): ご夫婦で営む小さな店、上品な味付け、自家製ちりめん山椒、刺身・煮物・揚げ物、8,000円のコース (玉子豆腐、鱧の刺身、賀茂茄子の田楽、若鮎の塩焼き、鴨ロース、柳川鍋、鱧の押し寿司、果物、抹茶)、料理ごとに箸を替える、メニューは日本語のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese menu only; smoking allowed; ten seats.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with bookable courses; reviews dated through July 2025.

kyoto_beer_cafe_bakujun.gf_detail: Not GF: a craft-beer bar whose food is mainly gyoza (reviews).
kyoto_beer_cafe_bakujun.vegan_detail: Ask. Gyoza come in several fillings, including ume-shiso and ginger, but most contain meat (reviews).
kyoto_beer_cafe_bakujun.hours_raw: Tuesday–Thursday and Saturday 16:00–23:00; Friday and Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A reverse-L counter and a few small tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2021–2022 reviews). On the ground floor of the ホテルメルディア四条河原町 annex, about 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
kyoto_beer_cafe_bakujun.notes: [Craft beer · south of Shijo, beer and gyoza] A long-running craft-beer bar on the ground floor of a hotel annex, with about eight rotating taps and an owner happy to explain each one. Pair a pint with gyoza in odd fillings — ume-shiso, ginger, curry — or mapo tofu. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2021–2026) describe a craft-beer bar that moved to a hotel annex around 2021 and celebrated 15 years in May 2026, run by a knowledgeable owner who explains the beers and recommends by style.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest came on the 15th-anniversary night, when the owner put seven special beers on tap.
An October 2022 visitor named it the go-to place for craft beer in Kyoto, thanks to the owner’s tasting notes.
A June 2024 guest came for the gyoza and stayed loyal to the mapo tofu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Beer Cafe 麦潤、ビアバー・バー、京都市下京区恵美須之町530 ホテルメルディア四条河原町アネックス1F、火〜木・土 16:00〜23:00、金・日 15:00〜22:00、月曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): ホテルのアネックスに移転、8つほどのタップ (京都醸造、かまど、ベルギー系)、瓶・缶も、店主がビールを説明、パイント1,300円 (2021年)、S 1,000円 (2026年5月)、宇都宮の専門店から仕入れる餃子 (しそ、梅しそ、生姜、カレー)、焼売、麻婆豆腐、田舎風パテ900円、15周年 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; the owner explains the beers.
